hunks.title: The kit
hunks.note: BuildKit: the pieces' records and everything about them that isn't one structure's - what they're called, cost, reach and look like, and the geometry they're built from.

bubbles.text: The sandbox switch (the --free-build user arg): nothing costs anything, nothing needs holding up, towns are no bar.

Every piece: its menu category, its kind (plate, edge, corner, cell or free - which decides how it snaps), its shape, its cost in units of its tier's materials and its nature (a foundation, a roof, a wall that bears weight, a door that swings, a light).

bubbles.at: static func cost(id: String, m: int)
bubbles.text: A piece's cost: its units in its tier's materials - timber, Building Stone, stone and marble, stone and bronze ingots.

bubbles.at: static func refund(pc: Dictionary, now: float)
bubbles.text: Taking a piece down: all of it back within a minute of placing it, half after that.
A plate's edges, each with its middle and the way out from it - the sockets walls, fences and neighbouring plates snap to.
A piece's mesh and solid blocks, merged into a chunk's builder: the walls with their door and window holes cut, frames, friezes, roofs, stairs, furniture - in its tier's and style's colour slots.
A wall with holes in it (doors, windows): strips of masonry round each hole, so a wall stays a handful of boxes.
A tier's and a style's look: which of building.gdshader's colour slots each part uses - timber framing, the empire's masonry and frieze, white marble, bronze plates.

files.explanation: A structure's rules, with no visuals: its pieces indexed by socket, what holds each one up and how far, what falls when one goes, where a new piece snaps and whether it fits.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,733 @@ 
+class_name BuildPlan
+extends RefCounted
+## A structure's pieces (BuildKit records, in its frame) and how they hold
+## together - the rules of building, no visuals:
+##
+## Sockets: every plate's edges and corners at its top, every edge piece's
+## top, every pillar's top - a new piece snaps to the socket nearest where
+## you aim (snap): a foundation beside a foundation, a wall on a floor's or a
+## foundation's edge or on the wall under it, a ceiling on the walls' tops
+## (or beside another ceiling), a pillar on a corner, stairs in a square cell,
+## a triangle against any edge - its other edges at 30 degree turns, the
+## layouts angled. One piece a socket (an edge, a corner, a cell); plates
+## never overlap (their outlines, any turn).
+##
+## Support (spans): foundations stand on the ground and hold up their tier's
+## span; a wall, a pillar, a beam, stairs carry what they stand on's span up
+## (never more than their own tier's); a ceiling or roof over walls / pillars
+## / beams takes theirs, and reaches out from them a cell at a time, one less
+## each cell (spans: timber 2, stone and marble 3, bronze 4 - past the cell
+## over a wall, timber 1 cell, stone 2, bronze 3). A piece with
+## nothing (span 0) holds up nothing and can't be placed; take a piece away
+## and whatever only it held comes down with it (falling()).
+
+var pieces: Array = []          # [record] (BuildKit)
+var spans := PackedInt32Array()
+## The ground's height in the frame under (x, z) - the foundations' fit (null: level at -0.4).
+var ground := Callable()
+
+var _plate := {}                # key(anchor) -> plate index
+var _plates_y := {}             # quarter metres of height -> [plate index]
+var _edge := {}                 # key(middle) -> edge piece index (ladders apart)
+var _ladder := {}
+var _corner := {}               # key(corner) -> pillar index
+var _cell := {}                 # key(middle) -> stairs index
+var _pedge := {}                # key(an edge's middle, at its plate's top) -> [plate index]
+var _pcorner := {}              # key(a corner, at its plate's top) -> [plate index]
+var last_snap := ""             # (snapping: the socket last shown, and its turn - kept against flicker)
+var last_r := -1
+var _free: Array = []           # [furniture index]
+var _pe_y := {}                 # quarter metres of height -> [[a, b, plate index]] (its edges: overlapping ones hold each other)
+var _we_y := {}                 # quarter metres of height (their feet) -> [[a, b, edge piece index]]
+var _spans_on := true           # (a town's buildings: no spans wanted - only the lookups)
+
+
+func _init(list: Array = [], with_spans := true) -> void:
+	pieces = list
+	_spans_on = with_spans
+	reindex()
+
+
+static func _yk(y: float) -> int:
+	return roundi(y * 4.0)
+
+
+## The lookups again (after any change) and the spans.
+func reindex() -> void:
+	_plate = {}
+	_plates_y = {}
+	_edge = {}
+	_ladder = {}
+	_corner = {}
+	_cell = {}
+	_pedge = {}
+	_pcorner = {}
+	_free = []
+	_pe_y = {}
+	_we_y = {}
+	for i in pieces.size():
+		var pc: Dictionary = pieces[i]
+		var I := BuildKit.info(str(pc["t"]))
+		var p := BuildKit.vec(pc["p"])
+		match str(I.get("kind", "")):
+			"plate":
+				_plate[BuildKit.key(p)] = i
+				var yk := _yk(p.y)
+				if not _plates_y.has(yk):
+					_plates_y[yk] = []
+				_plates_y[yk].append(i)
+				for e in BuildKit.edges(pc):
+					_push(_pedge, BuildKit.key(e[2]), i)
+					_push_k(_pe_y, yk, [e[0], e[1], i])
+				for c in BuildKit.corners(pc):
+					_push(_pcorner, BuildKit.key(c), i)
+			"edge":
+				if I.get("ladder", false) or I.get("outside", false):
+					_ladder[_ladder_key(pc)] = i
+				else:
+					_edge[BuildKit.key(p)] = i
+					var en := BuildKit.ends(pc)
+					_push_k(_we_y, _yk(p.y), [en[0], en[1], i])
+			"corner":
+				_corner[BuildKit.key(p)] = i
+			"cell":
+				_cell[BuildKit.key(p)] = i
+			"free":
+				_free.append(i)
+	if _spans_on:
+		compute_spans()
+
+
+static func _push(d: Dictionary, k: String, i: int) -> void:
+	if not d.has(k):
+		d[k] = []
+	d[k].append(i)
+
+
+static func _push_k(d: Dictionary, k: int, v) -> void:
+	if not d.has(k):
+		d[k] = []
+	d[k].append(v)
+
+
+## How much of two edges (along the ground) lie on each other, m: 0 unless they're on one line.
+static func overlap_len(a1: Vector3, b1: Vector3, a2: Vector3, b2: Vector3) -> float:
+	var A := Vector2(a1.x, a1.z)
+	var d := Vector2(b1.x, b1.z) - A
+	var L := d.length()
+	if L < 0.01:
+		return 0.0
+	d /= L
+	var n := Vector2(-d.y, d.x)
+	var p2 := Vector2(a2.x, a2.z) - A
+	var q2 := Vector2(b2.x, b2.z) - A
+	if absf(p2.dot(n)) > 0.06 or absf(q2.dot(n)) > 0.06:
+		return 0.0
+	var t0 := minf(p2.dot(d), q2.dot(d))
+	var t1 := maxf(p2.dot(d), q2.dot(d))
+	return maxf(0.0, minf(L, t1) - maxf(0.0, t0))
+
+
+## The plates whose edges lie along a..b at height y: [[index, overlap]].
+func _plates_along(a: Vector3, b: Vector3, y: float, me := -1) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	for e in _pe_y.get(_yk(y), []):
+		if int(e[2]) != me:
+			var o := overlap_len(a, b, e[0], e[1])
+			if o > 0.4:
+				out.append([int(e[2]), o])
+	return out
+
+
+static func _ladder_key(pc: Dictionary) -> String:
+	return BuildKit.key(BuildKit.vec(pc["p"])) + "|%s|%d" % [str(pc["t"]), posmod(int(pc.get("r", 0)), 12)]
+
+
+func _is(i: int, flag: String) -> bool:
+	return i >= 0 and i < pieces.size() and bool(BuildKit.info(str(pieces[i]["t"])).get(flag, false))
+
+
+func _sp(i: int, skip: int) -> int:
+	return 0 if i == skip or i < 0 or i >= spans.size() else spans[i]
+
+
+# --- Support -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## How far piece `pc` reaches (its span) from what holds it now: 0 nothing
+## holds it. `me`: its own index (-1: not placed yet); `skip`: a piece taken away.
+func support(pc: Dictionary, me := -1, skip := -1) -> int:
+	if BuildKit.free_build:
+		return 9   # (free building: everything holds)
+	var id := str(pc["t"])
+	var I := BuildKit.info(id)
+	var cap := 9 if I["kind"] == "free" else BuildKit.span_of(int(pc.get("m", 1)))
+	if I.get("found", false):
+		return cap
+	var p := BuildKit.vec(pc["p"])
+	var best := 0
+	var up := Vector3(0, BuildKit.WALL_H, 0)
+	match str(I["kind"]):
+		"plate":
+			for e in BuildKit.edges(pc):
+				for w in _we_y.get(_yk(p.y - BuildKit.WALL_H), []):   # (walls, beams under its edge)
+					var wi: int = w[2]
+					if wi != me and _is(wi, "bear") and overlap_len(e[0], e[1], w[0], w[1]) > 0.4:
+						best = maxi(best, mini(cap, _sp(wi, skip)))
+				for q in _plates_along(e[0], e[1], p.y, me):   # (a plate beside it: a cell further out)
+					best = maxi(best, mini(cap, _sp(q[0], skip) - 1))
+			for c in BuildKit.corners(pc):
+				var q: int = _corner.get(BuildKit.key(c - up), -1)
+				if q != me:
+					best = maxi(best, mini(cap, _sp(q, skip)))
+		"edge":
+			var k := BuildKit.key(p)
+			if I.get("hang", false):
+				var eh := BuildKit.ends(pc)
+				for q in _plates_along(eh[0], eh[1], p.y + BuildKit.WALL_H, me):
+					if not _is(q[0], "roof"):
+						best = maxi(best, mini(cap, _sp(q[0], skip)))
+			var en := BuildKit.ends(pc)
+			for q in _plates_along(en[0], en[1], p.y, me):   # (a floor or foundation under its foot)
+				var j: int = q[0]
+				if not _is(j, "roof") and float(q[1]) > 1.5:
+					if id == "steps" and not _is(j, "found"):
+						continue
+					best = maxi(best, mini(cap, _sp(j, skip)))
+			var w: int = _edge.get(BuildKit.key(p - up), -1)
+			if w != me and _is(w, "bear"):
+				best = maxi(best, mini(cap, _sp(w, skip)))
+			if I.get("ladder", false):
+				var w2: int = _edge.get(k, -1)
+				if _is(w2, "bear") or _is(w2, "post"):
+					best = maxi(best, mini(cap, _sp(w2, skip)))
+			if I.get("beam", false):
+				var vals := []
+				for e in BuildKit.ends(pc):
+					var q: int = _corner.get(BuildKit.key(e), -1)
+					if q >= 0 and q != me:
+						vals.append(_sp(q, skip))
+				if vals.size() == 2:
+					best = maxi(best, mini(cap, maxi(vals[0], vals[1])))
+				elif vals.size() == 1:
+					best = maxi(best, mini(cap, int(vals[0]) - 1))
+		"corner":
+			for j in _pcorner.get(BuildKit.key(p), []):
+				if j != me and not _is(j, "roof"):
+					best = maxi(best, mini(cap, _sp(j, skip)))
+			var q: int = _corner.get(BuildKit.key(p - up), -1)
+			if q != me:
+				best = maxi(best, mini(cap, _sp(q, skip)))
+		"cell":
+			var j: int = _plate.get(BuildKit.key(p), -1)
+			if j != me and j >= 0 and not _is(j, "roof"):
+				best = maxi(best, mini(cap, _sp(j, skip)))
+		"free":
+			if I.get("wallfix", false):
+				var w := wall_near(p, 0.5, me)
+				if w >= 0:
+					best = maxi(best, _sp(w, skip))
+			else:
+				var j := plate_under(p, me)
+				if j >= 0:
+					best = maxi(best, _sp(j, skip))
+				elif _ground_at(p.x, p.z) > p.y - 0.6:
+					best = cap   # (on the ground itself)
+	return clampi(best, 0, cap)
+
+
+## Every piece's span, from the ground up (`skip`: as if that one were gone).
+func compute_spans(skip := -1) -> void:
+	var n := pieces.size()
+	spans = PackedInt32Array()
+	spans.resize(n)
+	var order := range(n)
+	order.sort_custom(func(a, b): return BuildKit.vec(pieces[a]["p"]).y < BuildKit.vec(pieces[b]["p"]).y)
+	for pass_i in 64:
+		var changed := false
+		for i in order:
+			var v := 0 if i == skip else support(pieces[i], i, skip)
+			if v != spans[i]:
+				spans[i] = v
+				changed = true
+		if not changed:
+			break
+
+
+## What would come down with piece `i` (its index too): the pieces left with nothing holding them.
+func falling(i: int) -> Array:
+	compute_spans(i)
+	var out := [i]
+	for j in pieces.size():
+		if j != i and spans[j] <= 0:
+			out.append(j)
+	compute_spans()
+	return out
+
+
+# --- Lookups -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func plate_under(p: Vector3, me := -1) -> int:
+	for j in _plates_y.get(_yk(p.y), []):
+		if j != me and not _is(j, "roof") and _inside(BuildKit.corners(pieces[j]), p):
+			return j
+	return -1
+
+
+## The wall (an edge piece that stands, not a fence) within `d` of `p` along the ground at its level.
+func wall_near(p: Vector3, d: float, me := -1) -> int:
+	var best := -1
+	var bd := d
+	for k in _edge:
+		var j: int = _edge[k]
+		if j == me or not _is(j, "post") or _is(j, "low"):
+			continue
+		var q := BuildKit.vec(pieces[j]["p"])
+		if absf(q.y - p.y) > 0.1:
+			continue
+		var e := BuildKit.ends(pieces[j])
+		var dd := _seg_dist(Vector2(p.x, p.z), Vector2(e[0].x, e[0].z), Vector2(e[1].x, e[1].z))
+		if dd < bd:
+			bd = dd
+			best = j
+	return best
+
+
+static func _seg_dist(q: Vector2, a: Vector2, b: Vector2) -> float:
+	var ab := b - a
+	var t := clampf((q - a).dot(ab) / maxf(ab.length_squared(), 1e-9), 0.0, 1.0)
+	return (a + ab * t).distance_to(q)
+
+
+static func _inside(cs: Array, p: Vector3) -> bool:
+	var pos := false
+	var neg := false
+	for i in cs.size():
+		var a: Vector3 = cs[i]
+		var b: Vector3 = cs[(i + 1) % cs.size()]
+		var cr := (b.x - a.x) * (p.z - a.z) - (b.z - a.z) * (p.x - a.x)
+		if cr > 1e-6:
+			pos = true
+		elif cr < -1e-6:
+			neg = true
+	return not (pos and neg)
+
+
+func _ground_at(x: float, z: float) -> float:
+	return float(ground.call(x, z)) if ground.is_valid() else -0.4
+
+
+func index_at(k: String, kind: String) -> int:
+	match kind:
+		"plate": return _plate.get(k, -1)
+		"edge": return _edge.get(k, -1)
+		"corner": return _corner.get(k, -1)
+		"cell": return _cell.get(k, -1)
+	return -1
+
+
+# --- Snapping ------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## Where piece `id` would go aiming at `aim` (the frame's): the nearest socket
+## of the kind it takes, within `near` m - {t, p, r} (r turned `turned` times:
+## a quarter for squares and cells, half for walls, 30 degrees for furniture),
+## or {} (nothing to snap to). An empty plan: a foundation at the middle.
+##
+## `ray_o`, `ray_d` (the camera's line of sight, structure-local): sockets judged by
+## how near that line they are (it moves smoothly with the mouse - where it
+## first meets something jumps metres over an edge), the taken ones passed over,
+## the last one picked kept unless another is clearly nearer (no flicker
+## between two alike).
+func snap(id: String, aim: Vector3, turned := 0, near := 3.6, ray_o := Vector3.INF, ray_d := Vector3.ZERO) -> Dictionary:
+	var I := BuildKit.info(id)
+	if I.is_empty():
+		return {}
+	var best := {}
+	var bd := near
+	var up := Vector3(0, BuildKit.WALL_H, 0)
+	var cands: Array = []   # [p, r, the point it's judged by]
+	var idxs := []          # (the pieces near enough to offer a socket)
+	for j in pieces.size():
+		if BuildKit.vec(pieces[j]["p"]).distance_to(aim) < near + 7.0:
+			idxs.append(j)
+	match str(I["kind"]):
+		"plate":
+			var sh := str(I["shape"])
+			var tri := sh == "tri"
+			var inset := BuildKit.TRI_R if tri else BuildKit.CELL * 0.5
+			var lift := Vector3(0, BuildKit.RISE * 0.5, 0) if I.get("roof", false) else Vector3.ZERO
+			if pieces.is_empty() and I.get("found", false):
+				return {"t": id, "p": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0], "r": 0}
+			for j in idxs:
+				var pj: Dictionary = pieces[j]
+				var J := BuildKit.info(str(pj["t"]))
+				if J["kind"] == "plate":
+					if I.get("found", false) != J.get("found", false):
+						continue
+					for e in BuildKit.edges(pj):
+						cands.append_array(attach(sh, e[0], e[1], e[3], turned, lift))
+				elif J["kind"] == "edge" and (J.get("bear", false) or J.get("post", false)) and not J.get("low", false) and not I.get("found", false):
+					var en := BuildKit.ends(pj)
+					var n := BuildKit.turn(int(pj.get("r", 0))) * Vector3(0, 0, 1)
+					for sd: float in [1.0, -1.0]:
+						cands.append_array(attach(sh, en[0] + up, en[1] + up, n * sd, turned, lift))
+				elif J["kind"] == "corner" and not I.get("found", false) and sh in ["sq", "quarter"]:
+					inset = BuildKit.extent(sh).x
+					var top := BuildKit.vec(pj["p"]) + up
+					var b := BuildKit.turn(int(pj.get("r", 0)))
+					for k in 4:   # (a square on a pillar: the four cells round its top)
+						var d := b * Vector3((1 if k % 2 else -1) * inset, 0, (1 if k < 2 else -1) * inset)
+						cands.append([top + d, int(pj.get("r", 0)), top + d + lift])
+			if I.get("found", false) and not tri:   # (a foundation off on its own, on the frame's grid - halves and quarters on its half cells)
+				var ex := BuildKit.extent(sh)
+				var g := Vector3(floorf(aim.x / (ex.x * 2.0)) * ex.x * 2.0 + ex.x, 0.0, floorf(aim.z / (ex.y * 2.0)) * ex.y * 2.0 + ex.y)
+				cands.append([g, 0, g + Vector3(0, 0.3, 0)])
+			var step := 3 if sh in ["sq", "quarter"] else 0
+			for c in cands:
+				c[1] = posmod(int(c[1]) + step * turned, 12)
+		"edge":
+			var hang: bool = I.get("hang", false)
+			var mid_h := minf(BuildKit.height(id), BuildKit.H) * 0.5
+			for j in idxs:
+				var pj: Dictionary = pieces[j]
+				var J := BuildKit.info(str(pj["t"]))
+				if J["kind"] == "plate" and not J.get("roof", false):
+					if id == "steps" and not J.get("found", false):
+						continue
+					for e in BuildKit.edges(pj):
+						if (e[0] as Vector3).distance_to(e[1]) < BuildKit.CELL - 0.1:
+							continue   # (a wall takes a whole cell's edge)
+						var at: Vector3 = (e[2] as Vector3) - (up if hang else Vector3.ZERO)
+						if id == "steps" and _pedge.get(BuildKit.key(e[2]), []).size() > 1:
+							continue   # (steps only on an outer edge)
+						var n: Vector3 = e[3]
+						if id == "ladder" and (aim - at).dot(n) < 0.0:
+							n = -n
+						cands.append([at, BuildKit.r_facing(n), at + Vector3(0, mid_h if not hang else BuildKit.H - 0.5, 0)])
+				elif J["kind"] == "edge" and (J.get("bear", false) or J.get("post", false) or J.get("gable", false)) and id != "steps":
+					var base := BuildKit.vec(pj["p"])
+					var r0 := int(pj.get("r", 0))
+					if id == "ladder":   # (against the wall, on the side you're looking from)
+						var n := BuildKit.turn(r0) * Vector3(0, 0, 1)
+						if (aim - base).dot(n) < 0.0:
+							n = -n
+						cands.append([base, BuildKit.r_facing(n), base + Vector3(0, 1.6, 0) + n * 0.3])
+					elif not J.get("low", false) and not J.get("gable", false):
+						cands.append([base + up, r0, base + up + Vector3(0, mid_h, 0)])
+				elif J["kind"] == "corner" and I.get("beam", false):
+					var base := BuildKit.vec(pj["p"])
+					for k in 12:
+						var d := BuildKit.turn(k) * Vector3(BuildKit.CELL * 0.5, 0, 0)
+						cands.append([base + d, k, base + d + Vector3(0, BuildKit.H - 0.3, 0)])
+			for c in cands:
+				c[1] = posmod(int(c[1]) + 6 * turned, 12)
+		"corner":
+			for j in idxs:
+				var pj: Dictionary = pieces[j]
+				var J := BuildKit.info(str(pj["t"]))
+				if J["kind"] == "plate" and not J.get("roof", false):
+					for c in BuildKit.corners(pj):
+						cands.append([c, int(pj.get("r", 0)), c + Vector3(0, 1.5, 0)])
+				elif J["kind"] == "corner":
+					var top := BuildKit.vec(pj["p"]) + up
+					cands.append([top, int(pj.get("r", 0)), top + Vector3(0, 1.5, 0)])
+		"cell":
+			for j in idxs:
+				var pj: Dictionary = pieces[j]
+				var J := BuildKit.info(str(pj["t"]))
+				if J["kind"] == "plate" and not J.get("roof", false) and str(J["shape"]) == "sq":
+					var at := BuildKit.vec(pj["p"])
+					cands.append([at, posmod(int(pj.get("r", 0)) + 3 * turned, 12), at + Vector3(0, 1.0, 0)])
+		"free":
+			return snap_free(id, aim, turned)
+	var by_ray := ray_o != Vector3.INF
+	var kind := str(I["kind"])
+	for c in cands:
+		var q: Vector3 = c[2]
+		var d := q.distance_to(aim)
+		if by_ray:
+			if d > near * 1.6:
+				continue
+			var t := maxf(0.0, (q - ray_o).dot(ray_d))
+			d = q.distance_to(ray_o + ray_d * t) + d * 0.15
+			if _taken(kind, I, c[0]):
+				continue
+			if BuildKit.key(c[0]) == last_snap and int(c[1]) == last_r:
+				d -= 0.5   # (the one already shown: kept unless another's clearly nearer)
+		if d < bd:
+			bd = d
+			best = {"t": id, "p": BuildKit.arr(c[0]), "r": int(c[1])}
+	if by_ray:
+		last_snap = BuildKit.key(BuildKit.vec(best["p"])) if not best.is_empty() else ""
+		last_r = int(best.get("r", -1))
+	return best
+
+
+## (Snapping) A socket already filled by a piece of this kind.
+func _taken(kind: String, I: Dictionary, at: Vector3) -> bool:
+	var k := BuildKit.key(at)
+	match kind:
+		"plate":
+			return _plate.has(k)
+		"edge":
+			return not (I.get("ladder", false) or I.get("outside", false)) and _edge.has(k)
+		"corner":
+			return _corner.has(k)
+		"cell":
+			return _cell.has(k)
+	return false
+
+
+## A plate of shape `sh` against the edge a..b (`n` out from it): its places
+## [anchor, turn, judged-by point] - centred on an edge its width, side by side
+## along a longer one (a quarter twice along a cell's edge), an end lined up on a
+## shorter one; a half against it by its long side, or (turned) its short one.
+static func attach(sh: String, a: Vector3, b: Vector3, n: Vector3, turned: int, lift: Vector3) -> Array:
+	var L := Vector2(b.x - a.x, b.z - a.z).length()
+	var ex := BuildKit.extent(sh)
+	var W := ex.x * 2.0
+	var D := ex.y * 2.0
+	var r := BuildKit.r_facing(n)
+	if sh == "tri":
+		D = BuildKit.TRI_R * 2.0
+	elif sh == "half" and turned % 2 == 1:
+		W = ex.y * 2.0
+		D = ex.x * 2.0
+		r = BuildKit.r_along(n)   # (its long side out from the edge)
+	var dir := (b - a).normalized()
+	var offs := []
+	if absf(W - L) < 0.1:
+		offs = [0.0]
+	elif W < L:
+		for k in roundi(L / W):
+			offs.append(-L * 0.5 + W * 0.5 + k * W)
+	else:
+		offs = [(W - L) * 0.5, -(W - L) * 0.5]
+	var out := []
+	for o: float in offs:
+		var at: Vector3 = (a + b) * 0.5 + dir * o + n * (D * 0.5)
+		out.append([at, r, at + lift])
+	return out
+
+
+## A piece of furniture where you aim: on a floor, set square to it on a half metre
+## grid; a wall lamp on the wall's face; on the ground, as it is.
+func snap_free(id: String, aim: Vector3, turned := 0, free := false) -> Dictionary:
+	if BuildKit.info(id).get("wallfix", false):
+		var lv := floorf((aim.y + 0.2) / BuildKit.WALL_H) * BuildKit.WALL_H
+		var w := wall_near(Vector3(aim.x, lv, aim.z), 1.2)
+		if w < 0:
+			w = wall_near(Vector3(aim.x, lv - BuildKit.WALL_H, aim.z), 1.2)
+		if w < 0:
+			return {}
+		var pw: Dictionary = pieces[w]
+		var base := BuildKit.vec(pw["p"])
+		var b := BuildKit.turn(int(pw.get("r", 0)))
+		var l := b.inverse() * (aim - base)
+		var side := 1.0 if l.z >= 0.0 else -1.0
+		var x := clampf(snappedf(l.x, 0.5), -1.5, 1.5)
+		var at := base + b * Vector3(x, 0, side * (BuildKit.WALL_T * 0.5 + 0.07))
+		return {"t": id, "p": BuildKit.arr(at), "r": posmod(int(pw.get("r", 0)) + (0 if side > 0.0 else 6), 12)}
+	var j := plate_under(Vector3(aim.x, aim.y, aim.z)) if not free else -1
+	if j < 0:
+		for dy: float in [0.15, -0.15, 0.3]:
+			j = plate_under(Vector3(aim.x, snappedf(aim.y + dy, 0.25), aim.z)) if not free else -1
+			if j >= 0:
+				break
+	if j >= 0:
+		var pj: Dictionary = pieces[j]
+		var o := BuildKit.vec(pj["p"])
+		var b := BuildKit.turn(int(pj.get("r", 0)))
+		var l := b.inverse() * (aim - o)
+		var at := o + b * Vector3(snappedf(l.x, 0.5), 0, snappedf(l.z, 0.5))
+		return {"t": id, "p": BuildKit.arr(at), "r": posmod(int(pj.get("r", 0)) + 3 * turned, 12)}
+	return {"t": id, "p": BuildKit.arr(aim), "r": posmod(turned, 12)}
+
+
+# --- Can it go there? ------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## Why piece `pc` can't go where it is ("": it can) - its socket taken,
+## something in the way, the ground, nothing holding it up. Sets a
+## foundation's depth (`d`) to reach the ground.
+func check(pc: Dictionary) -> String:
+	var id := str(pc["t"])
+	var I := BuildKit.info(id)
+	var p := BuildKit.vec(pc["p"])
+	var k := BuildKit.key(p)
+	var up := Vector3(0, BuildKit.WALL_H, 0)
+	match str(I["kind"]):
+		"plate":
+			if _plate.has(k):
+				return "There's one there already"
+			var mine := BuildKit.corners(pc)
+			for j in _plates_y.get(_yk(p.y), []):
+				if _overlap(mine, BuildKit.corners(pieces[j])):
+					return "It overlaps another"
+			if _cell.has(BuildKit.key(p - up)) and str(pieces[_cell[BuildKit.key(p - up)]]["t"]) != "ladder":
+				return "The stairs come up here"
+			if I.get("found", false):
+				var lo := INF
+				var hi := -INF
+				var c := Vector3.ZERO
+				for q: Vector3 in mine:
+					var g := _ground_at(q.x, q.z)
+					lo = minf(lo, g)
+					hi = maxf(hi, g)
+					c += q
+				c /= mine.size()
+				var gm := _ground_at(c.x, c.z)
+				lo = minf(lo, gm)
+				hi = maxf(hi, gm)
+				if hi > p.y + 0.6:
+					return "The ground's too high here - dig it down"
+				if p.y - lo > 7.0:
+					return "Too steep - the ground falls away"
+				pc["d"] = snappedf(maxf(0.8, p.y - lo + 0.6), 0.01)
+		"edge":
+			if I.get("ladder", false) or I.get("outside", false):
+				if _ladder.has(_ladder_key(pc)):
+					return "There's one there already"
+			elif _edge.has(k):
+				return "There's one there already"
+		"corner":
+			if _corner.has(k):
+				return "There's one there already"
+		"cell":
+			if _cell.has(k):
+				return "There's one there already"
+			if _plate.has(BuildKit.key(p + up)):
+				return "No headroom - a ceiling over it"
+		"free":
+			for j in _free:
+				if BuildKit.vec(pieces[j]["p"]).distance_to(p) < 0.7:
+					return "Too close to another"
+	var s := support(pc)
+	if s <= 0:
+		if I["kind"] == "plate" and not I.get("found", false):
+			var n := BuildKit.span_of(int(pc.get("m", 1))) - 1
+			return "Too far from a support - %s reaches %d cell%s past a wall or pillar" % [BuildKit.tier_name(int(pc.get("m", 1))).to_lower(), n, "" if n == 1 else "s"]
+		return "Nothing holds it up"
+	return ""
+
+
+## Two outlines (convex, at one height) overlap - not just touch.
+static func _overlap(a: Array, b: Array) -> bool:
+	for poly in [a, b]:
+		for i in poly.size():
+			var p0: Vector3 = poly[i]
+			var p1: Vector3 = poly[(i + 1) % poly.size()]
+			var n := Vector2(p1.z - p0.z, -(p1.x - p0.x)).normalized()
+			var amin := INF
+			var amax := -INF
+			var bmin := INF
+			var bmax := -INF
+			for q: Vector3 in a:
+				var d := n.dot(Vector2(q.x, q.z))
+				amin = minf(amin, d)
+				amax = maxf(amax, d)
+			for q: Vector3 in b:
+				var d := n.dot(Vector2(q.x, q.z))
+				bmin = minf(bmin, d)
+				bmax = maxf(bmax, d)
+			if amax <= bmin + 0.05 or bmax <= amin + 0.05:
+				return false
+	return true
+
+
+# --- Changes ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func add(pc: Dictionary) -> int:
+	pieces.append(pc)
+	reindex()
+	return pieces.size() - 1
+
+
+## Takes piece `i` away, and what falls with it: the records taken (the first piece `i`'s).
+func remove(i: int) -> Array:
+	var gone := falling(i)
+	gone.sort()
+	var out := []
+	for j in range(gone.size() - 1, -1, -1):
+		out.push_front(pieces[gone[j]])
+		pieces.remove_at(gone[j])
+	# (piece i first in the list)
+	var first: Dictionary = out[gone.find(i)]
+	out.erase(first)
+	out.push_front(first)
+	reindex()
+	return out
+
+
+# --- Picking ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## The piece a ray (frame's) meets first within `limit`: [index, t] or [-1, INF].
+func pick(o: Vector3, d: Vector3, limit: float) -> Array:
+	var best := -1
+	var bt := limit
+	for i in pieces.size():
+		var box := pick_box(i)
+		var b := BuildKit.turn(int(pieces[i].get("r", 0)))
+		var c: Vector3 = box[0]
+		var lo := b.inverse() * (o - c)
+		var ld := b.inverse() * d
+		var t := CosmosSolids._ray_box(lo, ld, AABB(-(box[1] as Vector3), (box[1] as Vector3) * 2.0), bt)
+		if t < bt:
+			bt = t
+			best = i
+	return [best, bt]
+
+
+## A piece's box for picking: [middle (frame), half size (its own axes)].
+func pick_box(i: int) -> Array:
+	var pc: Dictionary = pieces[i]
+	var id := str(pc["t"])
+	var I := BuildKit.info(id)
+	var p := BuildKit.vec(pc["p"])
+	var h := BuildKit.CELL * 0.5
+	match str(I["kind"]):
+		"plate":
+			var ex := BuildKit.extent(str(I["shape"]))
+			if I.get("roof", false):
+				return [p + Vector3(0, BuildKit.RISE * 0.45, 0), Vector3(ex.x, BuildKit.RISE * 0.5, ex.y)]
+			if I.get("found", false):
+				return [p - Vector3(0, 0.3, 0), Vector3(ex.x, 0.3, ex.y)]
+			return [p - Vector3(0, BuildKit.SLAB * 0.5, 0), Vector3(ex.x, BuildKit.SLAB * 0.5 + 0.02, ex.y)]
+		"edge":
+			if id == "steps":
+				return [p + BuildKit.turn(int(pc.get("r", 0))) * Vector3(0, -0.3, 0.8), Vector3(1.3, 0.3, 0.7)]
+			if I.get("ladder", false):
+				return [p + BuildKit.turn(int(pc.get("r", 0))) * Vector3(0, 1.6, 0.3), Vector3(0.35, 1.6, 0.15)]
+			var ht := BuildKit.height(id)
+			if I.get("hang", false):
+				return [p + Vector3(0, BuildKit.H - 0.5, 0), Vector3(h - 0.2, 0.5, 0.2)]
+			if I.get("beam", false):
+				return [p + Vector3(0, BuildKit.H - 0.3, 0), Vector3(h - 0.25, 0.3, 0.2)]
+			if I.get("gable", false):
+				return [p + Vector3(0, BuildKit.RISE * 0.5 - 0.1, 0), Vector3(h - 0.2, BuildKit.RISE * 0.5, 0.2)]
+			ht = minf(ht, BuildKit.H)
+			return [p + Vector3(0, ht * 0.5, 0), Vector3(h - 0.2, ht * 0.5, 0.2)]
+		"corner":
+			return [p + Vector3(0, BuildKit.H * 0.5, 0), Vector3(0.3, BuildKit.H * 0.5, 0.3)]
+		"cell":
+			return [p + Vector3(0, BuildKit.WALL_H * 0.5, 0), Vector3(h - 0.3, BuildKit.WALL_H * 0.5, h - 0.3)]
+	if I.get("wallfix", false):
+		return [p + BuildKit.turn(int(pc.get("r", 0))) * Vector3(0, 1.95, 0.2), Vector3(0.2, 0.3, 0.2)]
+	return [p + Vector3(0, 0.5, 0), Vector3(0.6, 0.5, 0.6)]
+
+
+## Where the walls meet: a post at each end of a wall, fence or doorway (not
+## where there's a pillar): [at (frame, its foot), height, tier, style, turn].
+func posts() -> Array:
+	var at := {}
+	for k in _edge:
+		var i: int = _edge[k]
+		if not _is(i, "post"):
+			continue
+		var pc: Dictionary = pieces[i]
+		var h := 1.15 if _is(i, "low") else BuildKit.H
+		for e in BuildKit.ends(pc):
+			var key := BuildKit.key(e)
+			if _corner.has(key):
+				continue
+			if not at.has(key) or float(at[key][1]) < h:
+				at[key] = [e, h, int(pc.get("m", 1)), str(pc.get("s", "minoa")), int(pc.get("r", 0))]
+	return at.values()

files.explanation: The builder in the game: your structures on the world you're on (raised from the save as you arrive), the aim and its preview, placing pieces and dragged runs, the build modes, materials, wear and the lights.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,1019 @@ 
+class_name CosmosBuilds
+extends Node3D
+## Your buildings (Cosmos): the structures on the world you're on - each a
+## CosmosStructure, kept in the save (CosmosGame.extra "structures": planet
+## id -> [record]) and raised again when you come back - and the builder, the
+## automaton's building tool (Inventory "tool:build"), in hand:
+##   - aim: a translucent preview of the piece where it would go, snapped to
+##     the nearest socket of what's built (BuildPlan.snap) - green when it fits,
+##     red when it doesn't (the HUD says why: no support, too far from one, the
+##     ground too high, its socket taken, what it costs and you lack);
+##   - a click places it (its cost taken: what you carry first, then the
+##     hold); held and dragged, a run of them - a wall's length, a floor's
+##     rectangle - placed on letting go;
+##   - K (or the middle button) turns it (a quarter for squares and stairs, a
+##     half for walls and doors, 30 degrees for furniture); P snapping off
+##     (furniture and foundations free where you aim); N the build menu (the
+##     pieces by category, the tier, the empire's style, a paint);
+##   - O the mode: place, demolish (the piece aimed at amber, and what would
+##     fall with it; a click takes it down, half its cost back - all of it
+##     within a minute), upgrade (the next tier, for the difference), paint.
+## Doors, gates, shutters and hatches open with a click (Cosmos.terminal_here);
+## a chest keeps things, a bed is where you wake, the workbench and the kiln are
+## your ship's fabricator and refinery; the braziers and wall lamps light the
+## rooms (the nearest LIGHTS of them).
+
+const REACH := 12.0             # m from you
+const JOIN := 9.0               # m: a piece aimed this near a structure's pieces joins it
+const LIGHTS := 8
+const MODES := ["place", "remove", "upgrade", "paint"]
+const MODE_NAMES := {"place": "Build", "remove": "Demolish", "upgrade": "Upgrade", "paint": "Paint"}
+
+var cosmos: Node
+var planet: CosmosPlanet
+var structures: Array = []
+
+# The builder's state (kept for the run).
+static var piece := "foundation"
+static var tier := 1
+static var style := "minoa"
+static var paint := 0
+static var mode := "place"
+static var snap_on := true
+static var turned := 0
+
+var aim_ok := false
+var aim_why := ""
+var aim_pc := {}                # (place: what would go; other modes: the piece aimed at)
+var aim_st: CosmosStructure = null
+var aim_falls := 0
+var aim_cost := {}
+var aim_frame := Transform3D()  # (a new structure's frame, if it starts one)
+var placed := 0
+var _ghost: MeshInstance3D
+var _ghost_key := ""
+var _ghosts: Array = []         # (a run's)
+var _held := false
+var _drag_from := {}
+var _drag_st: CosmosStructure = null
+var _drag_frame := Transform3D()
+var _run: Array = []            # [record] a drag's pieces
+var _t := 0.0
+var _sync_t := 0.0
+var _light_t := 0.0
+var _lamps: Array = []
+var _pick_cache := [-1, null, 0]
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	name = "Builds"
+	_ghost = MeshInstance3D.new()
+	_ghost.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+	_ghost.visible = false
+	add_child(_ghost)
+	if not BuildKit.STYLES.has(style):
+		style = "minoa"
+
+
+static func pid_of(pl: CosmosPlanet) -> String:
+	return str(pl.rec.get("id", pl.name))
+
+
+## The world's records in the save.
+static func records(pid: String) -> Array:
+	var all: Dictionary = CosmosGame.extra.get("structures", {})
+	if not all.has(pid):
+		all[pid] = []
+		CosmosGame.extra["structures"] = all
+	return all[pid]
+
+
+func tool_out() -> bool:
+	var w: Node = cosmos.get("walker") if cosmos else null
+	return w != null and w.get("deck") == null and ToolbarUse.held(cosmos) == "tool:build"
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if cosmos == null:
+		return
+	_sync_t -= delta
+	if _sync_t <= 0.0:
+		_sync_t = 0.5
+		_sync_planet()
+	_light_t -= delta
+	if _light_t <= 0.0:
+		_light_t = 0.4
+		_lights()
+	if tool_out() and planet:
+		_t -= delta
+		if _t <= 0.0:
+			_t = 1.0 / 30.0   # (the aim looked at 30 times a second, not every frame)
+			update_aim()
+		_ride()
+	elif _ghost.visible or not _ghosts.is_empty():
+		_ghost.visible = false
+		_clear_run()
+		_held = false
+
+
+## The structures of the world you're on (or flying low over) raised; another world's let go.
+func _sync_planet() -> void:
+	var pl: CosmosPlanet = null
+	var w: Node = cosmos.get("walker")
+	if w and w.get("planet"):
+		pl = w.planet
+	elif cosmos.has_method("life_planet"):
+		pl = cosmos.life_planet()
+	if pl == planet:
+		return
+	for st in structures:
+		if is_instance_valid(st):
+			st.queue_free()
+	structures = []
+	planet = pl
+	if pl == null:
+		return
+	for rec in records(pid_of(pl)):
+		_raise(rec)
+
+
+func _raise(rec: Dictionary) -> CosmosStructure:
+	var st := CosmosStructure.new()
+	st.setup(planet, rec)
+	planet.add_child(st)
+	st.transform = CosmosStructure.frame_of(rec)
+	structures.append(st)
+	return st
+
+
+## Everything built raised again (a loaded game: the records changed under it).
+func reload() -> void:
+	var pl := planet
+	planet = null
+	if pl:
+		for st in structures:
+			if is_instance_valid(st):
+				st.queue_free()
+		structures = []
+		planet = pl
+		for rec in records(pid_of(pl)):
+			_raise(rec)
+
+
+# --- Aiming ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _ray() -> Array:
+	var cam: Camera3D = cosmos.cam
+	return [cam.global_position, -cam.global_basis.z]
+
+
+## What's under the sights, and what the builder would do there.
+func update_aim() -> void:
+	var w: Node3D = cosmos.walker
+	var r := _ray()
+	var o: Vector3 = r[0]
+	var d: Vector3 = r[1]
+	var limit := REACH + o.distance_to(w.global_position)
+	if mode != "place":
+		_aim_piece(o, d, limit)
+		return
+	# Where the sights meet something: a structure's block or the ground.
+	var t := limit
+	var hit_st: CosmosStructure = null
+	for st: CosmosStructure in structures:
+		if not st.near(st.to_local(w.global_position), REACH + 6.0):
+			continue
+		var h: Array = st.ray_hit(st.to_local(o), st.global_basis.inverse() * d, t)
+		if float(h[0]) < t:
+			t = float(h[0])
+			hit_st = st
+	var g := ground_hit(o, d, t)
+	if g != Vector3.ZERO:
+		t = o.distance_to(g)
+		hit_st = null
+	var at := o + d * t
+	if at.distance_to(w.global_position) > REACH:
+		at = w.global_position + (at - w.global_position).limit_length(REACH)
+	# The structure it joins: the one hit, else the nearest with a piece near.
+	var st: CosmosStructure = hit_st
+	if st == null:
+		var bd := JOIN
+		for s2: CosmosStructure in structures:
+			var l := s2.to_local(at)
+			if not s2.near(l):
+				continue
+			for pc in s2.plan.pieces:
+				var dd := BuildKit.vec(pc["p"]).distance_to(l)
+				if dd < bd:
+					bd = dd
+					st = s2
+	aim_st = st
+	var pc := {}
+	var I := BuildKit.info(piece)
+	if st:
+		var l := st.to_local(at)
+		if snap_on:
+			pc = st.plan.snap(piece, l, turned, 3.6, st.to_local(o), (st.global_basis.inverse() * d).normalized())
+		elif I["kind"] == "free" or I.get("found", false):
+			pc = st.plan.snap_free(piece, l, turned, true)
+			if I.get("found", false):
+				pc["p"] = BuildKit.arr(Vector3(l.x, 0.0, l.z))
+		if pc.is_empty() and I["kind"] == "free":
+			pc = st.plan.snap_free(piece, l, turned)
+	else:
+		# (no structure there: a foundation, or furniture on the ground, starts one)
+		if _held and not _drag_from.is_empty() and _drag_st == null and I.get("found", false):
+			# (dragging out a new one's foundations: on the frame where the drag began, its grid)
+			aim_frame = _drag_frame
+			var lq := aim_frame.affine_inverse() * (planet.global_transform.affine_inverse() * at)
+			pc = {"t": piece, "p": [snappedf(lq.x, BuildKit.CELL), 0.0, snappedf(lq.z, BuildKit.CELL)], "r": 0}
+		elif I.get("found", false) or (I["kind"] == "free" and not I.get("wallfix", false)):
+			aim_frame = new_frame(at, -cam_basis().z)
+			pc = {"t": piece, "p": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0], "r": posmod(turned, 12) if I["kind"] == "free" else 0}
+			if I.get("found", false):
+				aim_frame.origin += aim_frame.basis.y * _new_top(at, aim_frame, str(I["shape"]))
+	aim_pc = pc
+	if pc.is_empty():
+		aim_ok = false
+		aim_why = "Nothing to fix it to here" if st == null else "No place for it there"
+		_ghost.visible = false
+		_clear_run()
+		return
+	pc["m"] = tier
+	pc["s"] = style
+	pc["c"] = paint
+	aim_why = why(st, pc)
+	aim_cost = BuildKit.cost(piece, tier)
+	aim_ok = aim_why == ""
+	if _held and not _drag_from.is_empty() and st == _drag_st:
+		_update_run(pc)
+	_show_ghost(st, pc, "ok" if aim_ok else "bad")
+
+
+## Why `pc` can't go on `st` (null: a new structure at aim_frame), "" if it can.
+func why(st: CosmosStructure, pc: Dictionary, extra := {}) -> String:
+	var fr: Transform3D = st.transform if st else aim_frame
+	var p := fr * BuildKit.vec(pc["p"])
+	if planet.shape.cleared(p.normalized()) and not BuildKit.free_build:
+		return "Not in a town"
+	var w: Node3D = cosmos.walker
+	if w and (planet.global_transform * p).distance_to(w.global_position) > REACH + 2.0:
+		return "Too far"
+	var r := ""
+	if st:
+		r = st.plan.check(pc)
+	else:
+		var tmp := BuildPlan.new([])
+		tmp.ground = func(x: float, z: float) -> float: return _ground_in(aim_frame, x, z)
+		r = tmp.check(pc)
+	if r != "":
+		return r
+	if BuildKit.free_build:
+		return ""
+	var c := BuildKit.cost(str(pc["t"]), int(pc.get("m", 1)))
+	for k in extra:
+		c[k] = int(c.get(k, 0)) + int(extra[k])
+	for k in c:
+		if have(k) < int(c[k]):
+			return "Needs %s - you have %d %s" % [BuildKit.cost_text(c), have(k), Items.display_name(k)]
+	return ""
+
+
+## The piece under the sights (demolish, upgrade, paint): aim_pc / aim_st, and what falls with it.
+func _aim_piece(o: Vector3, d: Vector3, limit: float) -> void:
+	var best := INF
+	var bi := -1
+	var bs: CosmosStructure = null
+	for st: CosmosStructure in structures:
+		var lo := st.to_local(o)
+		if not st.near(lo, limit + 6.0):
+			continue
+		var h: Array = st.plan.pick(lo, st.global_basis.inverse() * d, minf(best, limit))
+		if int(h[0]) >= 0 and float(h[1]) < best:
+			best = float(h[1])
+			bi = int(h[0])
+			bs = st
+	_clear_run()
+	if bi < 0:
+		aim_pc = {}
+		aim_st = null
+		aim_ok = false
+		aim_why = "Aim at a piece"
+		_ghost.visible = false
+		return
+	var pc: Dictionary = bs.plan.pieces[bi]
+	aim_pc = pc
+	aim_st = bs
+	aim_ok = true
+	aim_why = ""
+	aim_cost = {}
+	match mode:
+		"remove":
+			if _pick_cache[0] != bi or _pick_cache[1] != bs or _pick_cache[2] != bs.plan.pieces.size():
+				_pick_cache = [bi, bs, bs.plan.pieces.size(), bs.plan.falling(bi).size() - 1]
+			aim_falls = int(_pick_cache[3])
+			aim_cost = BuildKit.refund(pc, Time.get_unix_time_from_system())
+		"upgrade":
+			var m := int(pc.get("m", 1))
+			if m >= BuildKit.TIERS.size() - 1:
+				aim_ok = false
+				aim_why = "Bronze already - as strong as it gets"
+			else:
+				aim_cost = upgrade_cost(pc)
+				for k in aim_cost:
+					if have(k) < int(aim_cost[k]) and not BuildKit.free_build:
+						aim_ok = false
+						aim_why = "Needs %s" % BuildKit.cost_text(aim_cost)
+		"paint":
+			if int(pc.get("c", 0)) == paint:
+				aim_ok = false
+				aim_why = "Already that colour"
+	var show := pc.duplicate()
+	if mode == "upgrade" and aim_ok:
+		show["m"] = int(pc.get("m", 1)) + 1
+	if mode == "paint":
+		show["c"] = paint
+	_show_ghost(bs, show, "pick" if mode == "remove" else ("ok" if aim_ok else "bad"), 1.02)
+
+
+## The next tier's cost less a third of this one's (what's reused).
+static func upgrade_cost(pc: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	var m := int(pc.get("m", 1))
+	var c := BuildKit.cost(str(pc["t"]), m + 1)
+	var old := BuildKit.cost(str(pc["t"]), m)
+	for k in old:
+		if c.has(k):
+			c[k] = maxi(0, int(c[k]) - floori(int(old[k]) / 3.0))
+	return c
+
+
+func cam_basis() -> Basis:
+	return (cosmos.cam as Camera3D).global_basis
+
+
+## A new structure's frame at global `at` (planet-local origin), x across `look`.
+func new_frame(at: Vector3, look: Vector3) -> Transform3D:
+	var o := at - planet.global_position
+	var up := o.normalized()
+	var f := (look - up * look.dot(up))
+	if f.length() < 0.01:
+		f = up.cross(Vector3.RIGHT)
+	f = f.normalized()
+	var x := f.cross(up).normalized()   # (its +z the way you look: x your right... turned so -z faces you)
+	return Transform3D(Basis(x, up, x.cross(up)), o)
+
+
+## A first foundation's top over the frame's origin: level just above its highest corner.
+func _new_top(at: Vector3, fr: Transform3D, shape: String) -> float:
+	var hi := -INF
+	for q in BuildKit.outline(shape):
+		hi = maxf(hi, _ground_in(fr, q.x, q.y))
+	hi = maxf(hi, _ground_in(fr, 0.0, 0.0))
+	return hi + 0.3
+
+
+func _ground_in(fr: Transform3D, x: float, z: float) -> float:
+	var q := fr * Vector3(x, 0.0, z)
+	var hgt: float = planet.shape.floor_below(q) if planet.shape.carved_near(q) else planet.shape.height(q.normalized())
+	return (planet.radius + hgt) - q.length()
+
+
+## Where a line from `o` along `dir` meets the ground within `reach` (global), or ZERO.
+func ground_hit(o: Vector3, dir: Vector3, reach: float) -> Vector3:
+	var c := planet.global_position
+	var shape := planet.shape
+	var t0 := 0.0
+	var t := 0.5
+	while t <= reach:
+		if shape.density(o + dir * t - c) < 0.0:
+			for k in 6:
+				var mid := (t0 + t) * 0.5
+				if shape.density(o + dir * mid - c) < 0.0:
+					t = mid
+				else:
+					t0 = mid
+			return o + dir * t
+		t0 = t
+		t += 0.5
+	return Vector3.ZERO
+
+
+# --- The preview ---------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+static var _ghost_meshes := {}
+
+
+static func ghost_mesh(pc: Dictionary) -> ArrayMesh:
+	var k := "%s|%d|%s" % [pc["t"], int(pc.get("m", 1)), pc.get("s", "minoa")]
+	if _ghost_meshes.has(k):
+		return _ghost_meshes[k]
+	var b := CosmosTown.Builder.new()
+	var q := pc.duplicate()
+	q["p"] = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
+	q["r"] = 0
+	if not q.has("d"):
+		q["d"] = 1.0
+	var res := BuildKit.emit(b, q, true)
+	for mv: Dictionary in res["movers"]:   # (its leaves shut, in the preview too)
+		var lb: CosmosTown.Builder = mv["lb"]
+		var xf: Transform3D = mv["xf"]
+		var base := b.verts.size()
+		b.verts.append_array(xf * lb.verts)
+		b.norms.append_array(Transform3D(xf.basis, Vector3.ZERO) * lb.norms)
+		b.cols.append_array(lb.cols)
+		for i in lb.idx:
+			b.idx.append(i + base)
+	var m := b.mesh() if b.verts.size() > 0 else ArrayMesh.new()
+	if _ghost_meshes.size() > 120:
+		_ghost_meshes.clear()
+	_ghost_meshes[k] = m
+	return m
+
+
+func _show_ghost(st: CosmosStructure, pc: Dictionary, look: String, grow := 1.0) -> void:
+	_ghost.mesh = ghost_mesh(pc)
+	_ghost.material_override = BuildKit.ghost_material(look)
+	var fr: Transform3D = st.global_transform if st else planet.global_transform * aim_frame
+	var p := BuildKit.vec(pc["p"])
+	_ghost.global_transform = fr * Transform3D(BuildKit.turn(int(pc.get("r", 0))).scaled(Vector3.ONE * grow), p)
+	_ghost.set_meta("on", planet.global_transform.affine_inverse() * _ghost.global_transform)
+	_ghost.visible = true
+
+
+# --- Placing -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## The fire button (the builder in hand): pressed - a placement (or the start
+## of a run), released - the run placed; in the other modes, a click.
+func trigger(on: bool) -> void:
+	if on == _held:
+		return
+	_held = on
+	if mode != "place":
+		if on:
+			click_mode()
+		return
+	if on:
+		if not aim_pc.is_empty():
+			_drag_from = aim_pc.duplicate(true)
+			_drag_st = aim_st
+			_drag_frame = aim_frame   # (a new structure's: kept while you drag - its grid)
+			_run = []
+	else:
+		if not _run.is_empty():
+			place_run()
+		elif not _drag_from.is_empty():
+			place(aim_st, aim_pc)
+		_drag_from = {}
+		_drag_st = null
+		_clear_run()
+
+
+## Places `pc` on `st` (null: a new structure at aim_frame) - its cost taken. True if it went.
+func place(st: CosmosStructure, pc: Dictionary, quiet := false) -> bool:
+	if pc.is_empty():
+		return false
+	pc = pc.duplicate(true)
+	pc["m"] = int(pc.get("m", tier))
+	pc["s"] = str(pc.get("s", style))
+	pc["c"] = int(pc.get("c", paint))
+	var r := why(st, pc)
+	if r != "":
+		if not quiet:
+			_say(r)
+		return false
+	if st == null:
+		var rec := {"o": BuildKit.arr(aim_frame.origin), "x": BuildKit.arr(aim_frame.basis.x), "pieces": []}
+		records(pid_of(planet)).append(rec)
+		st = _raise(rec)
+		st.plan.check(pc)   # (its depth into the ground)
+	spend(BuildKit.cost(str(pc["t"]), int(pc["m"])))
+	pc["at"] = Time.get_unix_time_from_system()
+	pc["own"] = "you"   # (who can lock and unlock it)
+	if BuildKit.info(str(pc["t"])).get("use", "") == "chest":
+		pc["inv"] = {}
+	st.plan.add(pc)
+	st.extent()
+	st.mark(pc)
+	st.poke()
+	var I := BuildKit.info(str(pc["t"]))
+	if I.get("found", false) or I["kind"] == "free" or str(pc["t"]) == "steps":
+		st.clear_ground()
+	placed += 1
+	_pick_cache = [-1, null, 0]
+	if cosmos.has_method("note_event"):
+		cosmos.note_event("built")
+	Sfx.play("skill/land", -9.0, 0.12)   # (a block set down)
+	return true
+
+
+## A drag's run: from where it began to where you aim now - a wall's (or
+## fence's) length along its edge, a floor's (foundation's) rectangle - each
+## piece checked as if the run's earlier ones were there.
+func _update_run(pc: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var a := BuildKit.vec(_drag_from["p"])
+	var b := BuildKit.vec(pc["p"])
+	var I := BuildKit.info(piece)
+	var want := []
+	var r0 := int(_drag_from.get("r", 0))
+	var bs := BuildKit.turn(r0)
+	var l := bs.inverse() * (b - a)
+	if I["kind"] == "edge" and absf(l.y) < 0.1:
+		var n := roundi(l.x / BuildKit.CELL)
+		for k in range(0, n + (1 if n >= 0 else -1), 1 if n >= 0 else -1):
+			want.append(a + bs * Vector3(k * BuildKit.CELL, 0, 0))
+	elif I["kind"] == "plate" and str(I["shape"]) == "sq" and absf(l.y) < 0.1:
+		var nx := clampi(roundi(l.x / BuildKit.CELL), -8, 8)
+		var nz := clampi(roundi(l.z / BuildKit.CELL), -8, 8)
+		for i in range(0, nx + (1 if nx >= 0 else -1), 1 if nx >= 0 else -1):
+			for j in range(0, nz + (1 if nz >= 0 else -1), 1 if nz >= 0 else -1):
+				want.append(a + bs * Vector3(i * BuildKit.CELL, 0, j * BuildKit.CELL))
+	if want.size() <= 1:
+		_clear_run()
+		return
+	want = want.slice(0, 32)
+	# (checked on a copy of the plan, each as if the ones before were built)
+	var tmp := BuildPlan.new(_drag_st.plan.pieces.duplicate(true) if _drag_st else [])
+	tmp.ground = _drag_st.plan.ground if _drag_st else func(x: float, z: float) -> float: return _ground_in(_drag_frame, x, z)
+	var total := {}
+	_run = []
+	for at: Vector3 in want:
+		var q := _drag_from.duplicate(true)
+		q["p"] = BuildKit.arr(at)
+		var ok := tmp.check(q) == "" and (BuildKit.free_build or not planet.shape.cleared(((_drag_st.transform if _drag_st else aim_frame) * at).normalized()))   # (towns no bar to free building - as for one piece, why())
+		if ok:
+			var c := BuildKit.cost(piece, tier)
+			for k in c:
+				total[k] = int(total.get(k, 0)) + int(c[k])
+			for k in total:
+				if have(k) < int(total[k]) and not BuildKit.free_build:
+					ok = false
+			if ok:
+				tmp.add(q)
+		_run.append([q, ok])
+	_show_run()
+
+
+func _show_run() -> void:
+	while _ghosts.size() < _run.size():
+		var g := MeshInstance3D.new()
+		g.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+		add_child(g)
+		_ghosts.append(g)
+	var fr: Transform3D = _drag_st.global_transform if _drag_st else planet.global_transform * aim_frame
+	for i in _ghosts.size():
+		var g: MeshInstance3D = _ghosts[i]
+		if i >= _run.size():
+			g.visible = false
+			continue
+		var q: Dictionary = _run[i][0]
+		g.mesh = ghost_mesh(q)
+		g.material_override = BuildKit.ghost_material("ok" if _run[i][1] else "bad")
+		g.global_transform = fr * Transform3D(BuildKit.turn(int(q.get("r", 0))), BuildKit.vec(q["p"]))
+		g.set_meta("on", planet.global_transform.affine_inverse() * g.global_transform)
+		g.visible = true
+	_ghost.visible = false
+
+
+## (Every frame) The previews kept on their world: the aim's looked at 30 times a
+## second, but the planet moves every frame (its orbit, the floating origin) - a
+## preview left where it was put drifts off and jumps back (a flicker).
+func _ride() -> void:
+	var pt := planet.global_transform
+	for g: MeshInstance3D in [_ghost] + _ghosts:
+		if g.visible and g.has_meta("on"):
+			g.global_transform = pt * (g.get_meta("on") as Transform3D)
+
+
+func _clear_run() -> void:
+	_run = []
+	for g in _ghosts:
+		(g as Node).queue_free()
+	_ghosts = []
+
+
+func place_run() -> int:
+	var n := 0
+	var st := _drag_st
+	for it in _run:
+		if not it[1]:
+			continue
+		if place(st, it[0], true):
+			n += 1
+			if st == null and not structures.is_empty():
+				st = structures[-1]
+	if n > 0:
+		cosmos.hud.flash("%d placed" % n, 2.0)
+	return n
+
+
+## A click in the other modes: the aimed piece taken down, upgraded or painted.
+func click_mode() -> void:
+	if aim_pc.is_empty() or aim_st == null:
+		return
+	if not aim_ok:
+		_say(aim_why)
+		return
+	match mode:
+		"remove": demolish(aim_st, aim_pc)
+		"upgrade": upgrade(aim_st, aim_pc)
+		"paint": recolour(aim_st, aim_pc, paint)
+
+
+## Takes piece `pc` down (and whatever it alone held up): its refund, a chest's things back in your hold.
+func demolish(st: CosmosStructure, pc: Dictionary) -> int:
+	var i := st.plan.pieces.find(pc)
+	if i < 0:
+		return 0
+	var back := BuildKit.refund(pc, Time.get_unix_time_from_system())
+	var gone := st.plan.remove(i)
+	for g: Dictionary in gone:
+		st.mark(g)
+		for k in g.get("inv", {}):
+			CosmosGame.data.add_item(k, int(g["inv"][k]))
+	give(back)
+	st.extent()
+	st.poke()
+	st.clear_ground()
+	_pick_cache = [-1, null, 0]
+	var msg := "%s taken down - %s back" % [BuildKit.title(str(pc["t"])), BuildKit.cost_text(back) if not back.is_empty() else "nothing"]
+	if gone.size() > 1:
+		msg += "; %d more fell with it" % (gone.size() - 1)
+	cosmos.hud.flash(msg, 3.0)
+	if st.plan.pieces.is_empty():
+		records(pid_of(planet)).erase(st.rec)
+		structures.erase(st)
+		st.queue_free()
+	return gone.size()
+
+
+func upgrade(st: CosmosStructure, pc: Dictionary) -> bool:
+	var m := int(pc.get("m", 1))
+	if m >= BuildKit.TIERS.size() - 1:
+		return false
+	var c := upgrade_cost(pc)
+	for k in c:
+		if have(k) < int(c[k]) and not BuildKit.free_build:
+			_say("Needs %s" % BuildKit.cost_text(c))
+			return false
+	spend(c)
+	Sfx.play("space/repair", -6.0)
+	pc["m"] = m + 1
+	pc.erase("hp")   # (made new in the better material: whole again)
+	st.plan.reindex()
+	st.mark(pc)
+	st.poke()
+	_pick_cache = [-1, null, 0]
+	cosmos.hud.flash("Now %s" % BuildKit.title(str(pc["t"]), m + 1), 2.0)
+	return true
+
+
+func recolour(st: CosmosStructure, pc: Dictionary, c: int) -> void:
+	pc["c"] = c
+	st.mark(pc)
+	st.poke()
+

+# --- Materials -----------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## How many of `id` you have: carried and in the hold.
+static func have(id: String) -> int:
+	var d: Node = CosmosGame.data
+	return int(d.carried.get(id, 0)) + d.count(id)
+
+
+## Takes `c` ({item: n}): what you carry first, then the hold.
+static func spend(c: Dictionary) -> void:
+	if BuildKit.free_build:
+		return
+	var d: Node = CosmosGame.data
+	for k in c:
+		var n := int(c[k])
+		n -= Inventory.take(d.carried, k, n)
+		if n > 0:
+			d.remove_item(k, mini(n, d.count(k)))
+	d.changed.emit()
+
+
+static func give(c: Dictionary) -> void:
+	for k in c:
+		CosmosGame.data.add_item(k, int(c[k]))
+
+
+func _say(t: String) -> void:
+	if cosmos and cosmos.hud:
+		cosmos.hud.flash(t, 2.5)
+

+# --- Using what's built -----------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## What a click does by you (Cosmos.terminal_here): [label, "build:<kind>:<n>:<key>"] or [].
+func prompt(w: Node3D) -> Array:
+	if tool_out():   # (the builder in hand: a click builds)
+		return []
+	var best := []
+	var bd := 2.4
+	for si in structures.size():
+		var st: CosmosStructure = structures[si]
+		var l := st.to_local(w.global_position)
+		if not st.near(l):
+			continue
+		for mv in st.movers:
+			var at: Vector3 = (mv["xf"] as Transform3D).origin
+			var pc := st.piece_of(str(mv["piece"]))
+			if pc.is_empty():
+				continue
+			var bx: AABB = mv["box"]
+			var mid: Vector3 = (mv["xf"] as Transform3D) * (bx.get_center() if bx.size != Vector3.ZERO else Vector3(0.35, 0.5, 0.0))
+			var dd := Vector2(l.x - mid.x, l.z - mid.z).length()
+			if l.y > at.y - 3.4 and l.y < at.y + 1.0 and dd < bd:
+				bd = dd
+				if bool(pc.get("lk", false)):
+					best = ["Locked - Y unlocks it", "build:locked:%d:%s" % [si, str(mv["piece"])]]
+				else:
+					best = [_door_label(pc), "build:toggle:%d:%s" % [si, str(mv["piece"])]]
+		for u in st.uses:
+			var at: Vector3 = u[1]
+			var dd := Vector2(l.x - at.x, l.z - at.z).length()
+			if absf(l.y - at.y) < 1.2 and dd < minf(bd, 1.5):
+				bd = dd
+				var label: String = {"chest": "Open the chest", "bed": "Rest (and wake here)", "fabricator": "Use the workbench (fabricator)", "refinery": "Use the kiln (refinery)"}.get(u[0], "Use")
+				best = [label, "build:%s:%d:%s" % [u[0], si, str(u[2])]]
+	return best
+
+
+static func _door_label(pc: Dictionary) -> String:
+	var open := bool(pc.get("o", false))
+	match str(pc["t"]):
+		"window": return "Open the shutters" if open else "Close the shutters"
+		"gate": return "Close the gate" if open else "Open the gate"
+		"hatch": return "Close the hatch" if open else "Open the hatch"
+		"fence_gate": return "Close the gate" if open else "Open the gate"
+	return "Close the door" if open else "Open the door"
+
+
+## Does it (from Cosmos.use_terminal).
+func use(id: String) -> void:
+	var parts := id.split(":", true, 3)
+	if parts.size() < 4:
+		return
+	var si := int(parts[2])
+	if si < 0 or si >= structures.size():
+		return
+	var st: CosmosStructure = structures[si]
+	var pc := st.piece_of(parts[3])
+	if pc.is_empty():
+		return
+	match parts[1]:
+		"toggle":
+			st.toggle(pc)
+		"locked":
+			_say("Locked")
+		"chest":
+			if cosmos.has_method("open_chest"):
+				cosmos.open_chest(pc)
+		"bed":
+			var w: Node = cosmos.walker
+			w.hp = CosmosWalker.MAX_HP
+			CosmosGame.data.stamina = Stamina.MAX
+			CosmosGame.extra["bed"] = {"planet": pid_of(planet), "at": BuildKit.arr(st.transform * BuildKit.vec(pc["p"]) + st.transform.basis.x * 0.95)}
+			cosmos.hud.flash("Rested - health and stamina back; you'll wake here", 3.0)
+		"fabricator", "refinery":
+			cosmos.open_device(parts[1])
+
+
+## Y by a door, gate or hatch you built: locked (shut, if it was open) or unlocked.
+## Locked, it won't open - for you until you unlock it, for anyone else ever (the
+## animals and raiders that come after you push an unlocked one open).
+func lock_near(w: Node3D) -> bool:
+	var best: Dictionary = {}
+	var bst: CosmosStructure = null
+	var bd := 2.6
+	for st: CosmosStructure in structures:
+		var l := st.to_local(w.global_position)
+		if not st.near(l):
+			continue
+		for mv in st.movers:
+			var pc := st.piece_of(str(mv["piece"]))
+			if pc.is_empty() or not BuildKit.lockable(str(pc["t"])):
+				continue
+			var at: Vector3 = (mv["xf"] as Transform3D).origin
+			var dd := Vector2(l.x - at.x, l.z - at.z).length()
+			if dd < bd and l.y > at.y - 3.4 and l.y < at.y + 1.0:
+				bd = dd
+				best = pc
+				bst = st
+	if best.is_empty():
+		return false
+	if str(best.get("own", "you")) != "you":
+		_say("Not yours to lock")
+		return true
+	best["lk"] = not bool(best.get("lk", false))
+	if best["lk"] and bool(best.get("o", false)):
+		bst.toggle(best)   # (shut first)
+	var what := str(BuildKit.info(str(best["t"]))["name"]).to_lower()
+	_say(("The %s locked" if best["lk"] else "The %s unlocked") % what)
+	return true
+
+
+## Pushes a body of someone else (an animal, a raider - global `at` its feet,
+## radius `r`) out of what's built - a shut door stops it; `opener`: it opens a
+## shut door it walks into (not a locked one).
+func push_body(at: Vector3, r: float, opener := false) -> Vector3:
+	var out := Vector3.ZERO
+	for st: CosmosStructure in structures:
+		var l := st.to_local(at)
+		if not st.near(l) or not st.is_built():
+			continue
+		if opener:
+			for mv in st.movers:
+				if mv.get("walk", false) or float(mv["cur"]) > 0.15:
+					continue
+				var pr = st._leaf_block(mv)
+				if pr and pr.depth(l.x, l.z) > -(r + 0.25) and absf(l.y - pr.y0) < 1.5:
+					var pc := st.piece_of(str(mv["piece"]))
+					if not pc.is_empty() and not bool(pc.get("lk", false)) and not bool(pc.get("o", false)):
+						st.toggle(pc)
+		out += st.global_basis * st.push(l, r)
+	return out
+
+
+# --- Wear and breaking ---------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## A bolt's flight from `a` along `dir`, `L` long (global): the first built
+## block it meets stops it, and the piece there takes `dmg`. True if one did.
+func bolt_hit(a: Vector3, dir: Vector3, L: float, dmg: float) -> bool:
+	for st: CosmosStructure in structures:
+		if not is_instance_valid(st) or not st.is_built():
+			continue
+		var lo := st.to_local(a)
+		if not st.near(lo, L):
+			continue
+		var ld := st.global_basis.inverse() * dir
+		var h: Array = st.ray_hit(lo, ld, L)
+		if float(h[0]) < L:
+			var pk: Array = st.plan.pick(lo, ld, float(h[0]) + 0.6)
+			if int(pk[0]) >= 0:
+				damage(st, int(pk[0]), dmg)
+			return true
+	return false
+
+
+## Something hitting what's built round global `at` (within `r`: the terrain
+## digger's carve): the nearest piece takes `dmg`. True if one was there.
+func damage_at(at: Vector3, r: float, dmg: float) -> bool:
+	for st: CosmosStructure in structures:
+		var l := st.to_local(at)
+		if not st.near(l, r):
+			continue
+		var bi := -1
+		var bdist := r
+		for i in st.plan.pieces.size():
+			var box := st.plan.pick_box(i)
+			var q: Vector3 = BuildKit.turn(int(st.plan.pieces[i].get("r", 0))).inverse() * (l - (box[0] as Vector3))
+			var he: Vector3 = box[1]
+			var dd := (q - q.clamp(-he, he)).length()
+			if dd < bdist:
+				bdist = dd
+				bi = i
+		if bi >= 0:
+			damage(st, bi, dmg)
+			return true
+	return false
+
+
+## Piece `i` of `st` worn by `dmg` of its toughness: past a quarter's mark, it
+## shows (its chunk built again, its look worse); at nothing left, it breaks -
+## and whatever only it held up comes down with it.
+func damage(st: CosmosStructure, i: int, dmg: float) -> void:
+	var pc: Dictionary = st.plan.pieces[i]
+	var before := BuildKit.wear_level(pc)
+	pc["hp"] = snappedf(maxf(0.0, BuildKit.hp_now(pc) - dmg), 0.1)
+	if float(pc["hp"]) <= 0.0:
+		var gone := st.plan.remove(i)
+		for g: Dictionary in gone:
+			st.mark(g)
+			for k in g.get("inv", {}):
+				CosmosGame.data.add_item(k, int(g["inv"][k]))
+		st.extent()
+		st.poke()
+		st.clear_ground()
+		_pick_cache = [-1, null, 0]
+		var msg := "%s broke" % BuildKit.title(str(pc["t"]), int(pc.get("m", 1)))
+		if gone.size() > 1:
+			msg += " - %d more came down with it" % (gone.size() - 1)
+		_say(msg)
+		Sfx.play("skill/land", -2.0, 0.2)
+		if st.plan.pieces.is_empty():
+			records(pid_of(planet)).erase(st.rec)
+			structures.erase(st)
+			st.queue_free()
+	elif BuildKit.wear_level(pc) != before:
+		st.mark(pc)
+		st.poke()
+
+
+## Where you wake when downed on world `pl` (planet-local), if you've a bed there - else null.
+static func bed_on(pl: CosmosPlanet):
+	var b: Dictionary = CosmosGame.extra.get("bed", {})
+	if b.is_empty() or str(b.get("planet", "")) != pid_of(pl):
+		return null
+	return BuildKit.vec(b["at"])
+
+
+# --- The walker, the ship and the lights --------------------------------------------------
+
+## The highest floor of what's built under planet-local `local` (not above its
+## feet + a step): metres above the radius, or -INF.
+func floor_at(pl: CosmosPlanet, local: Vector3) -> float:
+	if pl != planet:
+		return -INF
+	var best := -INF
+	for st: CosmosStructure in structures:
+		var tl := st.transform.affine_inverse() * local
+		if not st.near(tl) or not st.is_built():
+			continue
+		var top := st.floor_top(tl)
+		if top > -INF:
+			best = maxf(best, (st.transform * Vector3(tl.x, top, tl.z)).length() - pl.radius)
+	return best
+
+
+func push_walker(w: CosmosWalker) -> void:
+	if w.planet != planet:
+		return
+	for st: CosmosStructure in structures:
+		var l := st.to_local(w.global_position)
+		if st.near(l) and st.is_built():
+			w.global_position += st.global_basis * st.push(l, CosmosWalker.BODY_R)
+
+
+func indoors(p: Vector3) -> bool:
+	for st: CosmosStructure in structures:
+		var l := st.to_local(p)
+		if st.near(l) and st.indoors(l):
+			return true
+	return false
+
+
+## How far to move a ball (global `p`, radius `r`) out of what's built (your ship, low over it).
+func push_ball(p: Vector3, r: float) -> Vector3:
+	var out := Vector3.ZERO
+	for st: CosmosStructure in structures:
+		var l := st.to_local(p)
+		if st.near(l, r):
+			out += st.global_basis * st.push_ball(l, r)
+	return out
+
+
+## The braziers', wall lamps' and kilns' light: the nearest LIGHTS of them lit (no shadows).
+func _lights() -> void:
+	var w: Node3D = cosmos.get("walker")
+	var f: Vector3 = w.global_position if w else (cosmos.focus().global_position if cosmos.has_method("focus") else Vector3.ZERO)
+	var all := []
+	for st: CosmosStructure in structures:
+		if not is_instance_valid(st) or not st.near(st.to_local(f), 60.0):
+			continue
+		for l: Vector3 in st.lights:
+			var g := st.to_global(l)
+			all.append([g.distance_squared_to(f), g])
+	all.sort_custom(func(a, b): return a[0] < b[0])
+	while _lamps.size() < mini(all.size(), LIGHTS):
+		var o := OmniLight3D.new()
+		o.light_color = Color(1.0, 0.7, 0.42)
+		o.light_energy = 1.5
+		o.omni_range = 7.5
+		o.omni_attenuation = 1.2
+		o.shadow_enabled = false
+		add_child(o)
+		_lamps.append(o)
+	for i in _lamps.size():
+		var o: OmniLight3D = _lamps[i]
+		o.visible = i < all.size()
+		if o.visible:
+			o.global_position = all[i][1]

bubbles.text: Thirty times a second: where the sights meet a structure or the ground, which structure that joins (or a new one's frame), the piece snapped there, and why it can't go if it can't.

bubbles.at: func why(st: CosmosStructure, pc: Dictionary, extra := {}) -> String:
bubbles.text: The reason shown in red: a town's ground, too far, the plan's rules, or the materials you're short of (none of these but the rules with free building).
Every frame: the previews put back on their world - the planet moves every frame, the aim only 30 times a second, and a preview left behind flickered.
The fire button: pressed starts a placement or a drag (a new structure's frame kept while you drag), released places it or the whole run.
A dragged run: a wall's length along its edge or a rectangle of plates, each checked on a copy of the plan as if the ones before it were built.

bubbles.at: func place(st: CosmosStructure, pc: Dictionary, quiet := false) -> bool:
bubbles.text: A piece placed: checked, paid for, added to its structure (or a new one started), its chunk rebuilt, the save updated.

bubbles.at: func demolish(st: CosmosStructure, pc: Dictionary) -> int:
bubbles.text: A piece taken down with everything only it held up; its refund and a chest's things back in your hold.

bubbles.at: func upgrade(st: CosmosStructure, pc: Dictionary) -> bool:
bubbles.text: The next tier for the difference in cost - and the piece whole again (there is no repair).

files.explanation: What's solid in a built place: the towns' buildings and your own share it - boxes and sloped prisms in a grid, for standing on floors, being pushed out of walls, the camera's and the bolts' hits.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,373 @@ 
+class_name CosmosSolids
+extends Node3D
+## What's solid in a built place you walk through - a town's buildings
+## (CosmosTown), a structure of your own (CosmosStructure): blocks in its frame
+## (y up), each an AABB (the fast, common case) or a Prism (a convex outline
+## on the ground, its foot and top: a wall turned 30 degrees, a triangle of
+## floor, a step of a spiral stair; its top may slope - a roof, a ramp),
+## gathered in a grid of GRID m cells. The same blocks are floors (what's
+## under your feet that's not above them + STEP: stairs, roofs, ceilings),
+## walls (a body pushed out of them along the ground), the ship's hull's
+## and the camera's obstacles. No physics bodies: plain geometry, looked up
+## in the grid's cell.
+
+const STEP := 0.7              # m: walked up onto (stairs); higher blocks
+const GRID := 8.0              # the solids' grid
+const BODY_H := 1.8
+
+var _solids: Array = []        # [AABB or Prism] (local)
+var _grid := {}                # Vector2i -> PackedInt32Array
+var ground := 0.0              # (the floor where there's no block: a town's levelled ground; -INF: the world's own)
+
+
+## A convex block: `poly` its outline (x, z - any winding), y0 its foot, y1 its
+## top - or, with `planes`, its top a slope: each plane (a, b, c) a height
+## a x + b z + c, the top the lowest of them (mode 1: a hip's ridge) or the
+## highest (mode 2: a valley), clamped to y0 .. y1.
+class Prism:
+	var poly := PackedVector2Array()
+	var nrm := PackedVector2Array()   # (each edge's outward normal)
+	var y0 := 0.0
+	var y1 := 0.0
+	var planes: Array = []           # [Vector3(a, b, c)]
+	var mode := 0
+	var rect := Rect2()
+
+	func _init(p: PackedVector2Array, a: float, b: float, pl: Array = [], m := 0) -> void:
+		y0 = a
+		y1 = b
+		planes = pl
+		mode = m
+		var c := Vector2.ZERO
+		for q in p:
+			c += q
+		c /= maxf(1.0, p.size())
+		# (counter-clockwise, seen from above with x right and z down the page: the normals out)
+		var area := 0.0
+		for i in p.size():
+			var u := p[i]
+			var v := p[(i + 1) % p.size()]
+			area += u.x * v.y - v.x * u.y
+		poly = p if area > 0.0 else _reversed(p)
+		for i in poly.size():
+			var e := poly[(i + 1) % poly.size()] - poly[i]
+			var n := Vector2(e.y, -e.x).normalized()
+			if n.dot(poly[i] - c) < 0.0:
+				n = -n
+			nrm.append(n)
+		rect = Rect2(poly[0], Vector2.ZERO)
+		for q in poly:
+			rect = rect.expand(q)
+
+	static func _reversed(p: PackedVector2Array) -> PackedVector2Array:
+		var out := PackedVector2Array()
+		for i in range(p.size() - 1, -1, -1):
+			out.append(p[i])
+		return out
+
+	## How far inside (> 0) - the least depth past any edge; < 0 outside.
+	func depth(x: float, z: float) -> float:
+		var d := INF
+		var q := Vector2(x, z)
+		for i in poly.size():
+			d = minf(d, -(q - poly[i]).dot(nrm[i]))
+		return d
+
+	func has(x: float, z: float) -> bool:
+		return depth(x, z) >= 0.0
+
+	func top_at(x: float, z: float) -> float:
+		if planes.is_empty():
+			return y1
+		var t := INF if mode != 2 else -INF
+		for pl: Vector3 in planes:
+			var h := pl.x * x + pl.y * z + pl.z
+			t = minf(t, h) if mode != 2 else maxf(t, h)
+		return clampf(t, y0, y1)
+
+	## The nearest point of its outline to (x, z) - (x, z) itself when inside.
+	func nearest(x: float, z: float) -> Vector2:
+		var q := Vector2(x, z)
+		if has(x, z):
+			return q
+		var best := q
+		var bd := INF
+		for i in poly.size():
+			var a := poly[i]
+			var b := poly[(i + 1) % poly.size()]
+			var ab := b - a
+			var t := clampf((q - a).dot(ab) / maxf(ab.length_squared(), 1e-9), 0.0, 1.0)
+			var p := a + ab * t
+			var d := p.distance_squared_to(q)
+			if d < bd:
+				bd = d
+				best = p
+		return best
+
+	func aabb() -> AABB:
+		return AABB(Vector3(rect.position.x, y0, rect.position.y), Vector3(rect.size.x, y1 - y0, rect.size.y))
+
+	## Where a ray first enters it (t), or INF.
+	func ray(o: Vector3, d: Vector3, limit: float) -> float:
+		var t0 := 0.0
+		var t1 := limit
+		# (its foot and top - a sloped top as its highest: the camera's, a little early on a roof)
+		if absf(d.y) < 1e-8:
+			if o.y < y0 or o.y > y1:
+				return INF
+		else:
+			var ta := (y0 - o.y) / d.y
+			var tb := (y1 - o.y) / d.y
+			t0 = maxf(t0, minf(ta, tb))
+			t1 = minf(t1, maxf(ta, tb))
+		for i in poly.size():
+			var n := nrm[i]
+			var dn := d.x * n.x + d.z * n.y
+			var on := (o.x - poly[i].x) * n.x + (o.z - poly[i].y) * n.y   # (> 0: outside this edge)
+			if absf(dn) < 1e-9:
+				if on > 0.0:
+					return INF
+				continue
+			var t := -on / dn
+			if dn < 0.0:
+				t0 = maxf(t0, t)
+			else:
+				t1 = minf(t1, t)
+			if t0 > t1:
+				return INF
+		return t0 if t0 > 0.0 and t0 <= t1 else INF
+
+
+## Fewer, longer blocks: boxes lying end to end (the same height and depth,
+## within `gap` of each other along x, then z, then up) made one - a building's
+## wall pieces along a side one block, its storeys' walls one. Prisms kept as they are.
+static func merge_boxes(solids: Array, gap := 0.4) -> Array:
+	var boxes: Array = []
+	var rest: Array = []
+	for s in solids:
+		if s is AABB:
+			boxes.append(s)
+		else:
+			rest.append(s)
+	for ax in [0, 2, 1]:
+		var o1: int = 1 if ax != 1 else 0
+		var o2: int = 2 if ax != 2 else 0
+		var groups := {}
+		for b: AABB in boxes:
+			var k := "%d,%d,%d,%d" % [roundi(b.position[o1] * 50.0), roundi(b.end[o1] * 50.0), roundi(b.position[o2] * 50.0), roundi(b.end[o2] * 50.0)]
+			if not groups.has(k):
+				groups[k] = []
+			groups[k].append(b)
+		boxes = []
+		for k in groups:
+			var list: Array = groups[k]
+			list.sort_custom(func(a: AABB, b: AABB): return a.position[ax] < b.position[ax])
+			var cur: AABB = list[0]
+			for i in range(1, list.size()):
+				var nb: AABB = list[i]
+				if nb.position[ax] <= cur.end[ax] + gap:
+					cur = cur.merge(nb)
+				else:
+					boxes.append(cur)
+					cur = nb
+			boxes.append(cur)
+	return boxes + rest
+
+
+## The grid over `solids`: Vector2i cell -> the indices of what's in it (a margin of 1 m).
+static func grid_of(solids: Array) -> Dictionary:
+	var g := {}
+	for i in solids.size():
+		var b: AABB = solids[i] if solids[i] is AABB else (solids[i] as Prism).aabb()
+		for x in range(floori((b.position.x - 1.0) / GRID), floori((b.end.x + 1.0) / GRID) + 1):
+			for z in range(floori((b.position.z - 1.0) / GRID), floori((b.end.z + 1.0) / GRID) + 1):
+				var k := Vector2i(x, z)
+				if not g.has(k):
+					g[k] = PackedInt32Array()
+				var a: PackedInt32Array = g[k]
+				a.append(i)
+				g[k] = a
+	return g
+
+
+func _cell(p: Vector3) -> PackedInt32Array:
+	return _grid.get(Vector2i(floori(p.x / GRID), floori(p.z / GRID)), PackedInt32Array())
+
+
+# --- Walking: floors and walls ---------------------------------------------------------
+
+## The highest floor under local `p` that's not above its feet + STEP
+## (`ground` where there's none: steps, roofs), local y.
+func floor_top(p: Vector3) -> float:
+	var best := ground
+	for i in _cell(p):
+		var s = _solids[i]
+		var top: float
+		if s is AABB:
+			var b: AABB = s
+			if p.x < b.position.x or p.z < b.position.z or p.x > b.end.x or p.z > b.end.z:
+				continue
+			top = b.end.y
+		else:
+			var pr: Prism = s
+			if not pr.rect.has_point(Vector2(p.x, p.z)) or not pr.has(p.x, p.z):
+				continue
+			top = pr.top_at(p.x, p.z)
+		if top <= p.y + STEP and top > best:
+			best = top
+	return best
+
+
+## How far to move a body (local `p` its feet, radius `r`, BODY_H tall) out of
+## the blocks round it (local, along the ground).
+func push(p: Vector3, r: float) -> Vector3:
+	var out := Vector3.ZERO
+	for i in _cell(p):
+		var s = _solids[i]
+		var q := p + out
+		if s is AABB:
+			var b: AABB = s
+			if b.end.y <= p.y + STEP or b.position.y >= p.y + BODY_H:
+				continue
+			var dx0 := q.x - (b.position.x - r)
+			var dx1 := (b.end.x + r) - q.x
+			var dz0 := q.z - (b.position.z - r)
+			var dz1 := (b.end.z + r) - q.z
+			if dx0 <= 0.0 or dx1 <= 0.0 or dz0 <= 0.0 or dz1 <= 0.0:
+				continue
+			var m := minf(minf(dx0, dx1), minf(dz0, dz1))
+			if m == dx0:
+				out.x -= dx0
+			elif m == dx1:
+				out.x += dx1
+			elif m == dz0:
+				out.z -= dz0
+			else:
+				out.z += dz1
+		else:
+			out += _push_prism(s, q, r, p.y)
+	return out
+
+
+func _push_prism(pr: Prism, q: Vector3, r: float, feet: float) -> Vector3:
+	if pr.y0 >= feet + BODY_H or not pr.rect.grow(r).has_point(Vector2(q.x, q.z)):
+		return Vector3.ZERO
+	var near := pr.nearest(q.x, q.z)
+	if pr.top_at(near.x, near.y) <= feet + STEP:
+		return Vector3.ZERO   # (its top within a step where you'd meet it: walked onto, not into)
+	var dep := pr.depth(q.x, q.z)
+	if dep >= 0.0:   # (inside: out across the nearest edge)
+		var bi := 0
+		var bd := INF
+		for i in pr.poly.size():
+			var d := -(Vector2(q.x, q.z) - pr.poly[i]).dot(pr.nrm[i])
+			if d < bd:
+				bd = d
+				bi = i
+		var n := pr.nrm[bi]
+		return Vector3(n.x, 0.0, n.y) * (bd + r)
+	var away := Vector2(q.x, q.z) - near
+	var L := away.length()
+	if L >= r or L < 1e-6:
+		return Vector3.ZERO
+	away /= L
+	return Vector3(away.x, 0.0, away.y) * (r - L)
+
+
+## Under a roof or an upper floor (local `p`): indoors.
+func indoors(p: Vector3) -> bool:
+	for i in _cell(p):
+		var s = _solids[i]
+		var foot: float
+		if s is AABB:
+			var b: AABB = s
+			if not (p.x > b.position.x and p.z > b.position.z and p.x < b.end.x and p.z < b.end.z):
+				continue
+			foot = b.position.y
+		else:
+			var pr: Prism = s
+			if not pr.has(p.x, p.z):
+				continue
+			foot = pr.y0
+		if foot > p.y + 1.9 and foot < p.y + 6.0:
+			return true
+	return false
+
+
+## How far to move a ball (local `p`, radius `r`) out of the blocks (the ship).
+func push_ball(p: Vector3, r: float) -> Vector3:
+	var out := Vector3.ZERO
+	for i in _cell(p):
+		var b: AABB = _solids[i] if _solids[i] is AABB else (_solids[i] as Prism).aabb()
+		var q := p + out
+		var c := q.clamp(b.position, b.end)
+		var d := q - c
+		var dl := d.length()
+		if dl >= r:
+			continue
+		if dl > 0.0001:
+			out += d / dl * (r - dl)
+		else:   # (inside it: out the nearest face)
+			var best := INF
+			var push := Vector3.ZERO
+			for a in 3:
+				for sgn: float in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+					var depth: float = (b.end[a] - q[a] if sgn > 0.0 else q[a] - b.position[a]) + r
+					if depth < best:
+						best = depth
+						push = Vector3.ZERO
+						push[a] = depth * sgn
+			out += push
+	return out
+
+
+func is_built() -> bool:
+	return not _solids.is_empty()
+
+
+## The camera's line (Cosmos.camera_clear): where it first meets a block, or INF.
+func cam_hit(o: Vector3, dir: Vector3, limit: float) -> float:
+	if not is_built():
+		return INF
+	return ray_hit(to_local(o), global_basis.inverse() * dir, limit)[0]
+
+
+## A local ray's first block: [t, its index] ([INF, -1]: none within `limit`).
+func ray_hit(lo: Vector3, ld: Vector3, limit: float) -> Array:
+	var seen := {}
+	var best := INF
+	var bi := -1
+	var steps := int(limit / (GRID * 0.5)) + 1
+	for k in mini(steps, 40) + 1:
+		var p := lo + ld * minf(k * GRID * 0.5, limit)
+		for i in _cell(p):
+			if seen.has(i):
+				continue
+			seen[i] = true
+			var s = _solids[i]
+			var t := _ray_box(lo, ld, s, minf(limit, best)) if s is AABB else (s as Prism).ray(lo, ld, minf(limit, best))
+			if t < best:
+				best = t
+				bi = i
+	return [best, bi]
+
+
+static func _ray_box(o: Vector3, d: Vector3, b: AABB, limit: float) -> float:
+	var t0 := 0.0
+	var t1 := limit
+	for a in 3:
+		if absf(d[a]) < 1e-8:
+			if o[a] < b.position[a] or o[a] > b.end[a]:
+				return INF
+			continue
+		var ta := (b.position[a] - o[a]) / d[a]
+		var tb := (b.end[a] - o[a]) / d[a]
+		if ta > tb:
+			var x := ta
+			ta = tb
+			tb = x
+		t0 = maxf(t0, ta)
+		t1 = minf(t1, tb)
+		if t0 > t1:
+			return INF
+	return t0 if t0 > 0.0 else INF

bubbles.at: static func merge_boxes(solids: Array, gap := 0.4) -> Array:
bubbles.text: Wall blocks lying end to end merged into one - a city from about 4,900 blocks to about 2,880.

The floor under a point: the highest top below your feet - boxes and the slope of a prism.
