files.explanation: New: mineral veins buried 3-10 m under a rocky world's ground, found round you a 70 m cell at a time on a worker, each a ragged lode with tendrils. Digging into one gives its ore, far more than a surface deposit; the scanner shows the ones within 160 m as a hologram through the ground; what's left is saved.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,524 @@ 
+class_name CosmosVeins
+extends Node3D
+## Mineral veins in a world's ground (a child of Cosmos): ore bodies buried a few
+## metres down - a winding chain of a mineral, far richer than a deposit on the
+## surface - found round you a cell at a time (on a worker, as CosmosDeposits'),
+## mined by digging into them with the terrain digger (CosmosDeposits._dig: each
+## carve that cuts into one yields its ore). The scanner (CosmosSandbox.scan)
+## shows the ones near you as a ghost through the ground for a minute - where to
+## dig. What's left of each is kept in the save (CosmosGame.extra "veins").
+## Scanned, each is shown as a hologram through the ground (holo_mesh: its ore body a
+## glowing glass tube under a wireframe cage, vein_holo.gdshader) - its 3D shape at a
+## glance - for the scan's minute, dimmed by what's left of it. The terrain shader
+## knows them too (`vein_*`, sent by _send): the dug ground's walls (the voxels) solid
+## ore inside a vein.
+
+const CELL := 70.0               # m: one vein at most a cell
+const NEAR := 220.0              # m: the veins known round you
+const CHANCE := 0.4
+const SEEN := 160.0              # m: the scanner shows those within this
+const GHOST_TIME := 60.0         # s
+const PER_CARVE := 4             # units a carve that cuts into it
+const SENT := 16                 # the veins the terrain shader knows (the nearest; its VEINS)
+const SENT_PTS := 384            # their points (its vein_pts: each vein its chains one after another, a break (radius -1) between)
+const FADE := 6.0                # s: the ghost fading out at its end
+const HOLO_SIDES := 10           # the hologram tube's sides
+const HOLO_SUB := 4              # its rings between two of a vein's points (a smooth curve through them)
+
+var cosmos: Node
+var planet: CosmosPlanet
+var veins := {}                  # key -> {key, pts (planet-local), r, mineral, units, max}
+var _at := Vector3(INF, INF, INF)
+var _task := -1
+var _found: Array = []
+var _check := 0.0
+var ghosted := {}                # key -> true: the veins the scanner's shown (till ghost_until)
+var ghost_until := 0.0           # (s, ticks)
+var ghost_k := 0.0               # the ghost's strength now (the shader's)
+var _sent_mat: ShaderMaterial    # (the planet's terrain material the veins were sent to)
+var _sent_at := Vector3(INF, INF, INF)
+var _holo: MeshInstance3D        # (the scanned veins' hologram: a child of their world)
+static var _holo_mats: Array = []   # [skin, wire] (shared)
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	name = "Veins"
+
+
+func _exit_tree() -> void:
+	if _task != -1:
+		WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(_task)
+		_task = -1
+	if _sent_mat and is_instance_valid(_sent_mat):
+		_sent_mat.set_shader_parameter("vein_n", 0)
+		_sent_mat.set_shader_parameter("ghost_k", 0.0)
+	if is_instance_valid(_holo):
+		_holo.queue_free()
+
+
+func _pid() -> String:
+	return str(planet.rec.get("id", planet.name)) if planet else ""
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	var w: Node3D = cosmos.walker if cosmos else null
+	var pl: CosmosPlanet = w.get("planet") if w else null
+	if pl != planet:   # (another world, or none: its veins forgotten)
+		planet = pl
+		veins = {}
+		_at = Vector3(INF, INF, INF)
+		_clear_ghosts()
+		_send(Vector3.ZERO)
+	if planet == null or w.get("deck") != null:
+		return
+	var local: Vector3 = w.global_position - planet.global_position
+	if not ghosted.is_empty():   # (the ghost: on for its minute, fading out at the end)
+		var now := Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0
+		var k := clampf((ghost_until - now) / FADE, 0.0, 1.0)
+		if k <= 0.0:
+			_clear_ghosts()
+			_send(local)
+		elif absf(k - ghost_k) > 0.004:
+			ghost_k = k
+			for m: ShaderMaterial in holo_mats():
+				m.set_shader_parameter("k", k)
+	if local.distance_to(_sent_at) > 25.0:
+		_send(local)   # (walked on: the nearest veins again)
+	_check -= delta
+	if _task != -1 and WorkerThreadPool.is_task_completed(_task):
+		WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(_task)
+		_task = -1
+		_place(_found, local)
+		_send(local)
+	elif _task == -1 and _check <= 0.0 and local.distance_to(_at) > 30.0:
+		_check = 0.5
+		_at = local
+		var dug: Dictionary = CosmosGame.extra.get("veins", {}).get(_pid(), {})
+		var out := []
+		_found = out
+		var shape: PlanetShape = planet.shape
+		var r: float = planet.radius
+		var sd := int(shape.look.get("seed", 0.0) * 1000.0) + 7
+		var mix: Dictionary = CosmosDeposits.MIX.get(str(planet.rec.get("type", "")), CosmosDeposits.MIX[""])
+		var dd := dug.duplicate()
+		_task = WorkerThreadPool.add_task(func(): out.append_array(_find(shape, r, sd, mix, local, dd)), true, "veins")
+
+
+## (Worker) The veins within NEAR of `local`: [key, points, radius, mineral, units, max].
+static func _find(shape: PlanetShape, radius: float, sd: int, mix: Dictionary, local: Vector3, dug: Dictionary) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	if shape.kind != "rocky":
+		return out
+	var c0 := (local / CELL).floor()
+	var n := int(ceil(NEAR / CELL))
+	var total := 0.0
+	for m in mix:
+		total += float(mix[m])
+	for x in range(-n, n + 1):
+		for y in range(-n, n + 1):
+			for z in range(-n, n + 1):
+				var cell := c0 + Vector3(x, y, z)
+				var cc := (cell + Vector3(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)) * CELL
+				if absf(cc.length() - radius) > CELL * 1.5 or cc.distance_to(local) > NEAR + CELL:
+					continue
+				var key := "%d,%d,%d" % [cell.x, cell.y, cell.z]
+				var left := float(dug.get(key, 1.0))   # (a mined-out one still there: its ore gone, its walls seen)
+				var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+				rng.seed = hash([sd, key, "vein"])
+				if rng.randf() > CHANCE:
+					continue
+				var d := ((cell + Vector3(rng.randf(), rng.randf(), rng.randf())) * CELL).normalized()
+				var h := shape.height(d)
+				if (shape.sea > 0 and h < 1.0) or shape.cleared(d):
+					continue
+				var start := d * (radius + h - rng.randf_range(3.0, 10.0))
+				if (start / CELL).floor() != cell:
+					continue
+				var pick := rng.randf() * total
+				var mineral: String = mix.keys()[0]
+				for mm in mix:
+					pick -= float(mix[mm])
+					if pick <= 0.0:
+						mineral = mm
+						break
+				var body := _shape(rng, start, shape, radius)
+				var pts: Array = []
+				for q: Vector4 in body[0][0]:
+					pts.append(Vector3(q.x, q.y, q.z))
+				var units := roundi(float(body[1]) * rng.randf_range(4.0, 7.0) + 40.0)
+				out.append([key, pts, rng.randf_range(0.9, 1.7), mineral, maxi(1, roundi(units * left)) if left > 0.0 else 0, units, body])
+	return out
+
+
+## (Worker) A vein's body from `start`: a ragged, lumpy main lode wandering under the
+## ground (swelling and pinching), and tendrils branching off it - thinning to nothing,
+## kinking as they go, now and then forking again. Each chain [Vector4(point, radius)...]
+## (planet-local); kept a little under the ground. [chains (the main one first), their length (m)].
+static func _shape(rng: RandomNumberGenerator, start: Vector3, shape: PlanetShape, radius: float) -> Array:
+	var under := func(p: Vector3, dmin: float, dmax: float) -> Vector3:
+		var u := p.normalized()
+		var top := radius + shape.height(u)
+		return u * (top - clampf(top - p.length(), dmin, dmax))
+	var d := start.normalized()
+	var e := d.cross(Vector3.UP if absf(d.y) < 0.9 else Vector3.RIGHT).normalized().rotated(d, rng.randf() * TAU)
+	var base := rng.randf_range(0.8, 1.5)
+	var main: Array = [Vector4(start.x, start.y, start.z, base * rng.randf_range(0.6, 1.0))]
+	var p := start
+	var length := 0.0
+	for k in rng.randi_range(3, 5):   # (its core: short, ragged - a lump, not a worm)
+		e = e.rotated(p.normalized(), rng.randf_range(-1.5, 1.5))
+		var step := rng.randf_range(1.5, 3.2)
+		var q: Vector3 = under.call(p + e * step + p.normalized() * rng.randf_range(-1.6, 1.6), 2.2, 12.0)
+		length += q.distance_to(p)
+		p = q
+		main.append(Vector4(p.x, p.y, p.z, base * rng.randf_range(0.5, 1.7)))   # (swelling and pinching)
+	var tip: Vector4 = main[-1]
+	main[-1] = Vector4(tip.x, tip.y, tip.z, base * 0.3)
+	var chains: Array = [main]
+	var todo: Array = []   # [from point, direction, radius, forks left]
+	for t in rng.randi_range(3, 7):   # (tendrils, every way out of it)
+		var at: Vector4 = main[rng.randi_range(0, main.size() - 1)]
+		var o := Vector3(at.x, at.y, at.z)
+		var dir := e.rotated(o.normalized(), rng.randf_range(-PI, PI))
+		dir = (dir + o.normalized() * rng.randf_range(-0.6, 0.35)).normalized()   # (mostly down or level)
+		todo.append([o, dir, at.w * rng.randf_range(0.35, 0.6), 2])
+	while not todo.is_empty() and chains.size() < 15:
+		var tb: Array = todo.pop_back()
+		var q: Vector3 = tb[0]
+		var dir: Vector3 = tb[1]
+		var r0: float = tb[2]
+		var n := rng.randi_range(4, 8) - (2 - int(tb[3]))   # (forks shorter)
+		var ch: Array = [Vector4(q.x, q.y, q.z, r0)]
+		for k in n:
+			dir = (dir.rotated(q.normalized(), rng.randf_range(-0.9, 0.9)) + Vector3(rng.randf_range(-0.3, 0.3), rng.randf_range(-0.3, 0.3), rng.randf_range(-0.3, 0.3))).normalized()
+			var nq: Vector3 = under.call(q + dir * rng.randf_range(1.4, 3.2), 1.6, 15.0)
+			length += nq.distance_to(q)
+			q = nq
+			var r := r0 * pow(1.0 - float(k + 1) / n, 0.8) + 0.04   # (thinning to a point)
+			ch.append(Vector4(q.x, q.y, q.z, r))
+			if int(tb[3]) > 0 and k >= 1 and k < n - 1 and rng.randf() < 0.3:   # (a fork)
+				todo.append([q, dir.rotated(q.normalized(), rng.randf_range(0.6, 1.2) * (1.0 if rng.randf() < 0.5 else -1.0)), r * 0.8, int(tb[3]) - 1])
+		chains.append(ch)
+	return [chains, length]
+
+
+## A vein's chains (Vector4 point + radius); an old record without them: its one chain, as thick all along.
+static func chains_of(v: Dictionary) -> Array:
+	if v.has("chains"):
+		return v["chains"]
+	var ch: Array = []
+	for q: Vector3 in v["pts"]:
+		ch.append(Vector4(q.x, q.y, q.z, float(v["r"])))
+	return [ch]
+
+
+func _place(found: Array, local: Vector3) -> void:
+	var keep := {}
+	for f in found:
+		keep[f[0]] = true
+		if not veins.has(f[0]):
+			veins[f[0]] = {"key": f[0], "pts": f[1], "r": float(f[2]), "mineral": f[3], "units": int(f[4]), "max": int(f[5]), "chains": f[6][0]}
+	for k in veins.keys():
+		if not keep.has(k) and (veins[k]["pts"][0] as Vector3).distance_to(local) > NEAR + 60.0:
+			veins.erase(k)
+
+
+static func _seg_dist(p: Vector3, a: Vector3, b: Vector3) -> float:
+	var ab := b - a
+	var t := clampf((p - a).dot(ab) / maxf(ab.length_squared(), 1e-6), 0.0, 1.0)
+	return p.distance_to(a + ab * t)
+
+
+## The vein a carve at planet-local `c` (radius `r`) cuts into, or {}.
+func vein_at(c: Vector3, r: float) -> Dictionary:
+	for k in veins:
+		var v: Dictionary = veins[k]
+		if int(v["units"]) <= 0:
+			continue
+		for ch: Array in chains_of(v):
+			for i in ch.size() - 1:
+				var a: Vector4 = ch[i]
+				var b: Vector4 = ch[i + 1]
+				if _seg_dist(c, Vector3(a.x, a.y, a.z), Vector3(b.x, b.y, b.z)) < maxf(a.w, b.w) + r:
+					return v
+	return {}
+
+
+## A carve of the terrain digger at planet-local `c`: what it cuts out of a vein - into your pack. Units got.
+func dig(c: Vector3, r: float) -> int:
+	var v := vein_at(c, r)
+	if v.is_empty():
+		return 0
+	var data: Node = CosmosGame.data
+	var n := mini(mini(PER_CARVE, int(v["units"])), int(data.room_for(str(v["mineral"]))))
+	if n <= 0:
+		return -1   # (your pack's full)
+	v["units"] = int(v["units"]) - n
+	data.add_item(str(v["mineral"]), n)
+	if ghosted.has(v["key"]):
+		_send(_sent_at)   # (what's left of it: its ghost the dimmer)
+	var all: Dictionary = CosmosGame.extra.get("veins", {})
+	var mine: Dictionary = all.get(_pid(), {})
+	mine[v["key"]] = snappedf(float(v["units"]) / maxf(1.0, float(v["max"])), 0.001)
+	all[_pid()] = mine
+	CosmosGame.extra["veins"] = all
+	return n
+
+
+static func name_of(v: Dictionary) -> String:
+	return "%s vein" % Items.info(str(v["mineral"])).get("name", v["mineral"])
+
+
+## The scanner's pulse: the veins within SEEN of `me` (global) shown through the
+## ground as a ghost for a minute (the terrain shader's glow - see _send); the
+## ones with ore left, their [planet-local point, label] for its marks.
+func reveal(me: Vector3) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	if planet == null:
+		return out
+	var local := me - planet.global_position
+	_clear_ghosts()
+	for k in veins:
+		var v: Dictionary = veins[k]
+		var pts: Array = v["pts"]
+		if (pts[0] as Vector3).distance_to(local) > SEEN:
+			continue
+		ghosted[k] = true   # (mined out ones too: grey)
+		if int(v["units"]) <= 0:
+			continue
+		var top: Vector3 = pts[0]
+		var down := planet.radius + planet.shape.height(top.normalized()) - top.length()
+		out.append([top, "%s (%d) - %d m down" % [name_of(v), int(v["units"]), roundi(down)]])
+	if not ghosted.is_empty():
+		ghost_until = Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0 + GHOST_TIME
+		ghost_k = 1.0
+		_show_holo()
+	_send(local)
+	return out
+
+
+## The scanned veins' hologram (one mesh, two surfaces: the skin and the cage), on their world.
+func _show_holo() -> void:
+	var list: Array = []
+	for key in ghosted:
+		var v: Dictionary = veins.get(key, {})
+		if v.is_empty():
+			continue
+		var lk: Array = CosmosDeposits.LOOK.get(str(v["mineral"]), CosmosDeposits.LOOK["iron_ore"])
+		var c: Color = lk[0]
+		c.a = clampf(float(v["units"]) / maxf(1.0, float(v["max"])), 0.0, 1.0)
+		if int(v["units"]) <= 0:
+			c = Color(0.55, 0.58, 0.62, 0.0)   # (dug out: grey)
+		list.append({"chains": chains_of(v), "col": c})
+	if list.is_empty() or planet == null:
+		return
+	_holo = MeshInstance3D.new()
+	_holo.name = "VeinHologram"
+	_holo.mesh = holo_mesh(list)
+	_holo.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+	var mats := holo_mats()
+	_holo.set_surface_override_material(0, mats[0])
+	_holo.set_surface_override_material(1, mats[1])
+	for m: ShaderMaterial in mats:
+		m.set_shader_parameter("k", 1.0)
+		if planet.material and planet.material.get_shader_parameter("cut_n") != null:   # (what's been dug already: grey in it - and as you dig, CosmosPlanet._send_cuts)
+			m.set_shader_parameter("cuts", planet.material.get_shader_parameter("cuts"))
+			m.set_shader_parameter("cut_n", planet.material.get_shader_parameter("cut_n"))
+	planet.add_child(_holo)
+
+
+## The hologram's two materials: the glass skin, the wire cage (made once, shared; warmed at the title).
+static func holo_mats() -> Array:
+	if _holo_mats.is_empty():
+		var sh: Shader = load("res://shaders/world/vein_holo.gdshader")
+		for w in [0.0, 1.0]:
+			var m := ShaderMaterial.new()
+			m.shader = sh
+			m.set_shader_parameter("wire", w)
+			m.set_shader_parameter("cut_n", 0)
+			m.render_priority = 2
+			_holo_mats.append(m)
+	return _holo_mats
+
+
+## One chain of a vein (Vector4 point + radius) into the hologram's arrays: a smooth
+## curve through its points (HOLO_SUB rings between two), its radius eased between them.
+static func _holo_chain(ch: Array, col: Color, sv: PackedVector3Array, sn: PackedVector3Array, sc: PackedColorArray,
+		si: PackedInt32Array, lv: PackedVector3Array, lc: PackedColorArray) -> void:
+	if ch.size() < 2:
+		return
+	var ps: Array = []
+	for q: Vector4 in ch:
+		ps.append(Vector3(q.x, q.y, q.z))
+	var path: Array = []   # [point, is one of the vein's own points, radius]
+	for i in ps.size() - 1:
+		var p0: Vector3 = ps[maxi(i - 1, 0)]
+		var p1: Vector3 = ps[i]
+		var p2: Vector3 = ps[i + 1]
+		var p3: Vector3 = ps[mini(i + 2, ps.size() - 1)]
+		for j in HOLO_SUB:
+			var t := float(j) / HOLO_SUB
+			var t2 := t * t
+			var t3 := t2 * t
+			path.append([0.5 * (2.0 * p1 + (p2 - p0) * t + (2.0 * p0 - 5.0 * p1 + 4.0 * p2 - p3) * t2 + (3.0 * p1 - p0 - 3.0 * p2 + p3) * t3), j == 0,
+				lerpf((ch[i] as Vector4).w, (ch[i + 1] as Vector4).w, smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, t))])
+	path.append([ps[-1], true, (ch[-1] as Vector4).w])
+	var n := path.size()
+	var side := Vector3.ZERO   # (carried along the curve: the rings don't twist)
+	var base := sv.size()
+	var rings: Array = []
+	for i in n:
+		var p: Vector3 = path[i][0]
+		var tan: Vector3 = ((path[mini(i + 1, n - 1)][0] as Vector3) - (path[maxi(i - 1, 0)][0] as Vector3)).normalized()
+		if side == Vector3.ZERO:
+			side = tan.cross(p.normalized())
+			if side.length() < 0.1:
+				side = tan.cross(Vector3.RIGHT)
+		side = (side - tan * side.dot(tan)).normalized()
+		var up := tan.cross(side)
+		var rr: float = path[i][2]
+		var ring := PackedVector3Array()
+		for s in HOLO_SIDES:
+			var a := TAU * s / HOLO_SIDES
+			var dir := side * cos(a) + up * sin(a)
+			var q := p + dir * rr
+			sv.append(q)
+			sn.append(dir)
+			sc.append(col)
+			ring.append(q)
+		rings.append(ring)
+		if bool(path[i][1]) or i == 0 or i == n - 1:   # (the cage's rings: at the vein's own points)
+			for s in HOLO_SIDES:
+				lv.append(ring[s])
+				lv.append(ring[(s + 1) % HOLO_SIDES])
+				lc.append(col)
+				lc.append(col)
+	for i in n - 1:
+		for s in HOLO_SIDES:
+			var a0 := base + i * HOLO_SIDES + s
+			var a1 := base + i * HOLO_SIDES + (s + 1) % HOLO_SIDES
+			var b0 := a0 + HOLO_SIDES
+			var b1 := a1 + HOLO_SIDES
+			si.append_array([a0, b0, a1, a1, b0, b1])
+			lv.append((rings[i] as PackedVector3Array)[s])   # (the cage's lines along it)
+			lv.append((rings[i + 1] as PackedVector3Array)[s])
+			lc.append(col)
+			lc.append(col)
+
+
+## Veins as a hologram mesh: each [{chains (Vector4 point + radius) - or pts and r - , col}] its chains as
+## tubes along smooth curves through their points (_holo_chain), HOLO_SIDES round, as thick as its
+## ore there - surface 0 its skin (triangles), surface 1 its cage (lines: a ring at each of
+## its points, and HOLO_SIDES lines along it). Vertex colour: its ore's, alpha what's left.
+static func holo_mesh(list: Array) -> ArrayMesh:
+	var sv := PackedVector3Array()
+	var sn := PackedVector3Array()
+	var sc := PackedColorArray()
+	var si := PackedInt32Array()
+	var lv := PackedVector3Array()
+	var lc := PackedColorArray()
+	for v: Dictionary in list:
+		var col: Color = v["col"]
+		for ch: Array in chains_of(v):
+			_holo_chain(ch, col, sv, sn, sc, si, lv, lc)
+	var mesh := ArrayMesh.new()
+	if si.is_empty():
+		return mesh
+	var skin := []
+	skin.resize(Mesh.ARRAY_MAX)
+	skin[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] = sv
+	skin[Mesh.ARRAY_NORMAL] = sn
+	skin[Mesh.ARRAY_COLOR] = sc
+	skin[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX] = si
+	mesh.add_surface_from_arrays(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES, skin)
+	var cage := []
+	cage.resize(Mesh.ARRAY_MAX)
+	cage[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] = lv
+	cage[Mesh.ARRAY_COLOR] = lc
+	mesh.add_surface_from_arrays(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_LINES, cage)
+	return mesh
+
+
+## The veins shown by the scanner now.
+func ghosts() -> int:
+	return ghosted.size() if ghost_k > 0.0 else 0
+
+
+func _clear_ghosts() -> void:
+	ghosted = {}
+	ghost_k = 0.0
+	if is_instance_valid(_holo):
+		_holo.queue_free()
+	_holo = null
+
+
+## The veins round `local` (planet-local) to the planet's terrain shader: the
+## shown ones first, then the nearest - their chains (points, radius), colour
+## (LOOK's), what's left, metal / glow / crystal; how many are ghosted (the
+## first ones), the ghost's strength. Up to SENT of them (SENT_PTS points);
+## none on other worlds.
+func _send(local: Vector3) -> void:
+	var mat: ShaderMaterial = planet.material if planet and planet.shape.kind == "rocky" else null
+	if _sent_mat and _sent_mat != mat and is_instance_valid(_sent_mat):
+		_sent_mat.set_shader_parameter("vein_n", 0)
+		_sent_mat.set_shader_parameter("ghost_k", 0.0)
+	_sent_mat = mat
+	_sent_at = local
+	if mat == null:
+		return
+	var list: Array = veins.values()
+	list.sort_custom(func(a, b):
+		var ga := ghosted.has(a["key"])
+		if ga != ghosted.has(b["key"]):
+			return ga
+		return (a["pts"][0] as Vector3).distance_squared_to(local) < (b["pts"][0] as Vector3).distance_squared_to(local))
+	var bound := PackedVector4Array()
+	var col := PackedVector4Array()
+	var look := PackedVector4Array()
+	var span := PackedVector4Array()
+	var pts := PackedVector4Array()
+	var shown := 0
+	for v: Dictionary in list:
+		var flat: Array = []   # (its chains one after another, a break between: no segment joins them)
+		for ch: Array in chains_of(v):
+			if not flat.is_empty():
+				flat.append(Vector4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, -1.0))
+			flat.append_array(ch)
+		if bound.size() >= SENT or pts.size() + flat.size() > SENT_PTS:
+			break
+		var r := 0.0
+		var mid := Vector3.ZERO
+		var m := 0
+		for q: Vector4 in flat:
+			if q.w >= 0.0:
+				mid += Vector3(q.x, q.y, q.z)
+				r = maxf(r, q.w)
+				m += 1
+		mid /= maxi(m, 1)
+		var reach := 0.0
+		for q: Vector4 in flat:
+			if q.w >= 0.0:
+				reach = maxf(reach, mid.distance_to(Vector3(q.x, q.y, q.z)))
+		var lk: Array = CosmosDeposits.LOOK.get(str(v["mineral"]), CosmosDeposits.LOOK["iron_ore"])
+		var c: Color = lk[0]
+		span.append(Vector4(pts.size(), pts.size() + flat.size(), 0.0, 0.0))
+		pts.append_array(flat)
+		bound.append(Vector4(mid.x, mid.y, mid.z, reach + r * 2.7 + 0.5))   # (its ghost's halo across the ground; its ore's reach)
+		col.append(Vector4(c.r, c.g, c.b, clampf(float(v["units"]) / maxf(1.0, float(v["max"])), 0.0, 1.0)))
+		look.append(Vector4(float(lk[1]), float(lk[2]), 1.0 if lk[3] else 0.0, 0.0))
+		if ghosted.has(v["key"]):
+			shown += 1   # (they come first: the shader's ghost_n)
+	var n := bound.size()
+	bound.resize(SENT)
+	col.resize(SENT)
+	look.resize(SENT)
+	span.resize(SENT)
+	pts.resize(SENT_PTS)
+	mat.set_shader_parameter("vein_bound", bound)
+	mat.set_shader_parameter("vein_col", col)
+	mat.set_shader_parameter("vein_look", look)
+	mat.set_shader_parameter("vein_span", span)
+	mat.set_shader_parameter("vein_pts", pts)
+	mat.set_shader_parameter("vein_n", n)
+	mat.set_shader_parameter("ghost_n", 0)   # (no glow over the ground: the scanned ones are holograms now)
+	mat.set_shader_parameter("ghost_k", 0.0)
hunks.title: CosmosVeins
hunks.note: Veins are found on a worker as you walk, mined by the terrain digger, shown as a hologram after a scan for a minute, and passed to the terrain shader so dug walls show solid ore.

bubbles.text: Forgets the veins when you change worlds, fades the hologram over its last 6 s, re-sends the nearest veins after 25 m, and starts a worker search every 0.5 s once you've moved 30 m.

bubbles.at: static func _find(shape: PlanetShape, radius: float, sd: int, mix: Dictionary, local: Vector3, dug: Dictionary) -> Array:
bubbles.text: Visits the 70 m cells near the surface round you. Each has a 40% chance of a vein from its own seed, so the same vein is always found in the same place. The mineral comes from the planet type's mix; what's left comes from the save.

bubbles.at: static func _shape(rng: RandomNumberGenerator, start: Vector3, shape: PlanetShape, radius: float) -> Array:
bubbles.text: A short ragged core of 3-5 sharp turns, swelling and pinching, then 3-7 tendrils that kink, thin to a point and sometimes fork, up to 15 chains. Every point is kept 1.6-15 m under the ground.

bubbles.at: func vein_at(c: Vector3, r: float) -> Dictionary:
bubbles.text: A carve hits a vein if its middle comes within the segment's radius plus the carve's radius of any segment of any chain.

bubbles.at: func dig(c: Vector3, r: float) -> int:
bubbles.text: Takes up to 4 units into your pack and saves what's left as a fraction in CosmosGame.extra "veins".
The scanner's pulse: veins within 160 m are shown for 60 s (mined-out ones too, in grey), and the ones with ore get a mark with their name, units and depth.
One mesh for all scanned veins: a triangle surface for the glass tubes and a line surface for the cage, in the ore's colour, alpha what's left.
Packs up to 16 veins and 384 points into the terrain shader's uniforms, chains end to end with a radius -1 break between them, plus each one's bounds, colour and metal / glow / crystal look.

files.explanation: The voxel chunks can now say when the ground round a carve is built, so the planet only stops drawing the old ground once the new one is there. Their mesh is flagged so the terrain shader draws vein ore in dug walls.

@@ -1,0 +1,540 @@ 
+extends TestCase
+## The building kit (BuildKit, BuildPlan, CosmosStructure, CosmosBuilds): every
+## piece built in every tier and style, snapping to sockets, support and what
+## falls, costs and refunds, walking in and on what's built (walls, doorways,
+## doors, ceilings, stairs), and structures kept through a save.
+
+
+func _cosmos(sid := "atrapos") -> Cosmos:
+	Galaxy.current_system = sid
+	var c: Cosmos = load(Cosmos.SCENE).instantiate()
+	tree.root.add_child(c)
+	var t0 := Time.get_ticks_msec()
+	while not c.build_settled() and Time.get_ticks_msec() - t0 < 30000:
+		await tree.process_frame
+	return c
+
+
+static func _pc(t: String, p: Vector3, r := 0, m := 1, s := "minoa") -> Dictionary:
+	return {"t": t, "p": BuildKit.arr(p), "r": r, "m": m, "s": s, "c": 0}
+
+
+func test_every_piece_builds_in_every_tier() -> void:
+	var worst := 0
+	var bad := []
+	for id in BuildKit.PIECES:
+		for m in BuildKit.TIERS.size():
+			for s in ["minoa", "athens", "mycenae", "cyclades"]:
+				var b := CosmosTown.Builder.new()
+				var pc := _pc(id, Vector3(4, 3.2, 8), 1, m, s)
+				pc["d"] = 1.5
+				var res := BuildKit.emit(b, pc)
+				var n := b.verts.size()
+				worst = maxi(worst, n)
+				if n == 0 and id != "steps":
+					bad.append("%s/%d/%s: no faces" % [id, m, s])
+				if b.idx.size() % 3 != 0 or b.verts.size() != b.cols.size() or b.verts.size() != b.norms.size():
+					bad.append("%s: broken arrays" % id)
+				if (res["solids"] as Array).is_empty() and BuildKit.kind(id) != "free" and id != "sconce":
+					bad.append("%s/%d: nothing solid" % [id, m])
+	check(bad.is_empty(), "every piece has faces and solids (%s)" % ", ".join(bad.slice(0, 6)))
+	check(worst < 4000, "no piece too heavy (%d vertices at most)" % worst)
+	check(BuildKit.PIECES.size() >= 35, "an extensive kit (%d pieces)" % BuildKit.PIECES.size())
+	for cat in BuildKit.CATS:
+		check(not BuildKit.ids_in(str(cat[0])).is_empty(), "%s: pieces in it" % cat[1])
+	# Movers: a door has a leaf, a gate two, a window two shutters, a hatch its lid.
+	for e in [["door", 1], ["gate", 2], ["window", 2], ["hatch", 1], ["fence_gate", 1]]:
+		var res := BuildKit.emit(CosmosTown.Builder.new(), _pc(e[0], Vector3.ZERO))
+		check_eq((res["movers"] as Array).size(), e[1], "%s: its hinged leaves" % e[0])
+	check(not (BuildKit.emit(CosmosTown.Builder.new(), _pc("lamp", Vector3.ZERO))["lights"] as Array).is_empty(), "a brazier lights")
+	check(not (BuildKit.emit(CosmosTown.Builder.new(), _pc("chest", Vector3.ZERO))["uses"] as Array).is_empty(), "a chest is used")
+
+
+func test_snapping_to_sockets() -> void:
+	var plan := BuildPlan.new([])
+	var f0 := plan.snap("foundation", Vector3(1, 0, 1))
+	check(BuildKit.vec(f0["p"]) == Vector3.ZERO, "the first foundation: the structure's middle")
+	plan.add(_pc("foundation", Vector3.ZERO))
+	var f1 := plan.snap("foundation", Vector3(5.2, 0.2, 0.6))
+	check(BuildKit.vec(f1["p"]).distance_to(Vector3(4, 0, 0)) < 0.01, "a foundation snaps beside another (%s)" % str(f1["p"]))
+	check_eq(plan.check(f1.merged({"m": 1})), "", "and fits")
+	plan.add(_pc("foundation", Vector3(4, 0, 0)))
+	var tri := plan.snap("foundation_tri", Vector3(0.3, 0.1, -3.0))
+	var tp := BuildKit.vec(tri["p"])
+	check(absf(tp.z + 2.0 + BuildKit.TRI_R) < 0.01 and absf(tp.x) < 0.01, "a triangle against an edge (%s)" % str(tp))
+	check_eq(plan.check(tri.merged({"m": 1})), "", "the triangle fits")
+	plan.add(tri.merged({"m": 1, "s": "minoa"}))
+	# A triangle's slanted edge takes a square at 30 degrees.
+	var sq := plan.snap("foundation", tp + Vector3(-2.0, 0, -1.6))
+	check(not sq.is_empty() and int(sq["r"]) % 3 != 0, "a square off a triangle's slant, turned off the grid (r %s)" % str(sq.get("r")))
+	check_eq(plan.check(sq.merged({"m": 1})), "", "and fits beside it")
+	# Walls on the foundation's edges, facing out.
+	var w := plan.snap("wall", Vector3(-2.1, 1.4, 0.2))
+	check(BuildKit.vec(w["p"]).distance_to(Vector3(-2, 0, 0)) < 0.01, "a wall on the foundation's edge (%s)" % str(w["p"]))
+	for p in [Vector3(-2, 0, 0), Vector3(0, 0, 2), Vector3(6, 0, 0), Vector3(4, 0, 2)]:
+		var ww := plan.snap("wall", p + Vector3(0, 1.5, 0))
+		check_eq(plan.check(ww.merged({"m": 1})), "", "a wall at %s fits" % str(p))
+		plan.add(ww.merged({"m": 1, "s": "minoa"}))
+	var dup := plan.snap("wall", Vector3(-2, 1.5, 0))
+	check(plan.check(dup.merged({"m": 1})) != "", "one wall an edge")
+	# A wall on a wall (the next storey); a ceiling on the walls' tops.
+	var w2 := plan.snap("wall", Vector3(-2, 4.6, 0))
+	check(absf(BuildKit.vec(w2["p"]).y - BuildKit.WALL_H) < 0.01, "a wall stacked on a wall (%s)" % str(w2["p"]))
+	var ceil := plan.snap("floor", Vector3(0.5, 3.3, 0.2))
+	check(BuildKit.vec(ceil["p"]).distance_to(Vector3(0, BuildKit.WALL_H, 0)) < 0.01, "a ceiling on the walls (%s)" % str(ceil["p"]))
+	# A pillar on a corner; stairs in a cell, turned a quarter.
+	var pil := plan.snap("pillar", Vector3(5.8, 1.0, -1.8))
+	check(BuildKit.vec(pil["p"]).distance_to(Vector3(6, 0, -2)) < 0.01, "a pillar on a corner (%s)" % str(pil["p"]))
+	var st0 := plan.snap("stairs", Vector3(4, 1, 0))
+	var st1 := plan.snap("stairs", Vector3(4, 1, 0), 1)
+	check(BuildKit.vec(st0["p"]).distance_to(Vector3(4, 0, 0)) < 0.01 and posmod(int(st1["r"]) - int(st0["r"]), 12) == 3, "stairs in a cell, K turns them a quarter")
+	# Furniture on a floor's half metre grid.
+	var ch := plan.snap("chest", Vector3(0.62, 0.0, -0.9))
+	check(BuildKit.vec(ch["p"]).distance_to(Vector3(0.5, 0, -1.0)) < 0.01, "a chest set square on the floor (%s)" % str(ch["p"]))
+
+
+func test_support_spans_and_what_falls() -> void:
+	var plan := BuildPlan.new([])
+	plan.add(_pc("foundation", Vector3.ZERO))
+	var walls := []
+	for e in BuildKit.edges(plan.pieces[0]):
+		walls.append(plan.add(_pc("wall", e[2], BuildKit.r_facing(e[3]))))
+	check_eq(int(plan.spans[0]), 3, "a stone foundation holds 3")
+	check_eq(int(plan.spans[walls[0]]), 3, "a wall on it carries its span")
+	var ceil := _pc("floor", Vector3(0, BuildKit.WALL_H, 0))
+	check_eq(plan.check(ceil), "", "a ceiling on four walls")
+	plan.add(ceil)
+	# Out from the walls a cell at a time: the cell over a wall holds its span, each further one less.
+	var out := []
+	for k in range(1, 5):
+		var q := _pc("floor", Vector3(4 * k, BuildKit.WALL_H, 0))
+		out.append(plan.check(q))
+		if out[-1] == "":
+			plan.add(q)
+	check(out[0] == "" and out[1] == "" and out[2] == "", "stone: two cells out past the one over the wall (%s)" % str(out))
+	check(out[3].begins_with("Too far"), "the next too far from a support (%s)" % out[3])
+	var t1 := _pc("floor", Vector3(0, BuildKit.WALL_H, 4.0), 0, 0)
+	check_eq(plan.check(t1), "", "timber over the wall")
+	plan.add(t1)
+	var t2 := _pc("floor", Vector3(0, BuildKit.WALL_H, 8.0), 0, 0)
+	check_eq(plan.check(t2), "", "timber: one cell out")
+	plan.add(t2)
+	check(plan.check(_pc("floor", Vector3(0, BuildKit.WALL_H, 12.0), 0, 0)) != "", "timber: not two")
+	# All bronze: three cells out.
+	var bp := BuildPlan.new([_pc("foundation", Vector3.ZERO, 0, 3)])
+	for e in BuildKit.edges(bp.pieces[0]):
+		bp.add(_pc("wall", e[2], BuildKit.r_facing(e[3]), 3))
+	var bo := []
+	for k in range(1, 6):
+		var q := _pc("floor", Vector3(-4 * k, BuildKit.WALL_H, 0), 0, 3)
+		bo.append(bp.check(q))
+		if bo[-1] == "":
+			bp.add(q)
+	check(bo.slice(0, 4).all(func(r): return r == "") and bo[4] != "", "bronze reaches further (%s)" % str(bo))
+	check(plan.check(_pc("wall", Vector3(30, 0, 0))) == "Nothing holds it up", "a wall on nothing")
+	# Take a wall away: the ceiling's still held by the other three. The foundation: all of it.
+	var falls := plan.falling(walls[0])
+	check_eq(falls.size(), 1, "one wall less: nothing else falls")
+	var n0 := plan.pieces.size()
+	var gone := plan.remove(0)
+	check_eq(gone.size(), n0, "the foundation taken: everything on it falls (%d of %d)" % [gone.size(), n0])
+	check(plan.pieces.is_empty(), "nothing left standing")
+
+
+func test_costs_and_refunds() -> void:
+	if CosmosGame.data == null:
+		CosmosGame._fresh_data()
+		await tree.process_frame
+	var d: Node = CosmosGame.data
+	d.items.erase("stone")
+	d.carried.erase("stone")
+	check_eq(BuildKit.cost("wall", 1), {"stone": 4}, "a stone wall: 4 stone")
+	check(BuildKit.cost("wall", 0).has("timber"), "a timber one: timber")
+	check(BuildKit.cost("wall", 3).has("bronze_ingots"), "a bronze one: bronze ingots")
+	d.carried["stone"] = 3
+	d.add_item("stone", 5)
+	check_eq(CosmosBuilds.have("stone"), 8, "what you carry and the hold")
+	CosmosBuilds.spend({"stone": 4})
+	check(int(d.carried.get("stone", 0)) == 0 and d.count("stone") == 4, "spent: the carried first, then the hold")
+	var pc := _pc("wall", Vector3.ZERO)
+	pc["at"] = Time.get_unix_time_from_system()
+	check_eq(BuildKit.refund(pc, Time.get_unix_time_from_system() + 5.0), {"stone": 4}, "taken down within a minute: all back")
+	check_eq(BuildKit.refund(pc, Time.get_unix_time_from_system() + 600.0), {"stone": 2}, "later: half")
+	var up := CosmosBuilds.upgrade_cost(_pc("wall", Vector3.ZERO, 0, 1))
+	check(up.has("marble") and up.has("stone"), "an upgrade: the next tier's materials (%s)" % str(up))
+	d.items.erase("stone")
+
+
+## A little house on a level frame: foundations, walls, a doorway or door, a ceiling, stairs.
+func _house(st: CosmosStructure, door := "doorway") -> void:
+	var plan := st.plan
+	plan.add(_pc("foundation", Vector3.ZERO))
+	plan.add(_pc("foundation", Vector3(4, 0, 0)))
+	for e in BuildKit.edges(plan.pieces[0]):
+		var m: Vector3 = e[2]
+		if m.x > 1.0:
+			continue
+		plan.add(_pc(door if m.z < -1.0 else "wall", m, BuildKit.r_facing(e[3])))
+	plan.add(_pc("floor", Vector3(0, BuildKit.WALL_H, 0)))
+	plan.add(_pc("stairs", Vector3(4, 0, 0), 0))
+	for pc in plan.pieces:
+		pc["d"] = 1.0
+	plan.reindex()
+	st.extent()
+	st.mark_all()
+
+
+func _wait_built(st: CosmosStructure) -> void:
+	var t0 := Time.get_ticks_msec()
+	while st.busy() and Time.get_ticks_msec() - t0 < 10000:
+		await tree.process_frame
+
+
+func test_walking_in_what_is_built() -> void:
+	var st := CosmosStructure.new()
+	st.setup(null, {"o": [0, 1000, 0], "x": [1, 0, 0], "pieces": []})
+	tree.root.add_child(st)
+	_house(st)
+	await _wait_built(st)
+	check(st.is_built() and st.get_child_count() > 0, "its chunks in (%d solids)" % st._solids.size())
+	check(absf(st.floor_top(Vector3(0, 0.1, 0))) < 0.01, "standing on the foundation")
+	check(absf(st.floor_top(Vector3(0, 3.5, 0)) - BuildKit.WALL_H) < 0.01, "on the ceiling, up top")
+	check(st.indoors(Vector3(0, 0.05, 0)), "indoors under it")
+	# Walls hold you in: a body at the -x wall pushed back inside.
+	var push := st.push(Vector3(-1.95, 0.05, 0.3), CosmosWalker.BODY_R)
+	check(push.x > 0.2, "the wall pushes you back in (%s)" % str(push))
+	# The doorway (-z side) lets you through.
+	var dp := st.push(Vector3(0, 0.05, -2.0), CosmosWalker.BODY_R)
+	check(dp.length() < 0.05, "through the doorway (%s)" % str(dp))
+	# Up the stairs (in the +x cell, climbing along +z).
+	var p := Vector3(4, 0.0, -2.3)
+	var top := 0.0
+	for k in 160:
+		p.z += 0.03
+		var f := st.floor_top(p)
+		if f >= p.y - 0.01:
+			p.y = f
+		top = maxf(top, p.y)
+	check(top > BuildKit.WALL_H - 0.05, "up the stairs to the next floor (%.2f m)" % top)
+	st.queue_free()
+	await tree.process_frame
+	# A door: shut, it blocks the doorway; opened, it swings out of the way.
+	var st2 := CosmosStructure.new()
+	st2.setup(null, {"o": [0, 1000, 0], "x": [1, 0, 0], "pieces": []})
+	tree.root.add_child(st2)
+	_house(st2, "door")
+	await _wait_built(st2)
+	check_eq(st2.movers.size(), 1, "the door's leaf hung")
+	var shut := st2.push(Vector3(0, 0.05, -2.0), CosmosWalker.BODY_R)
+	check(shut.length() > 0.1, "a shut door blocks (%s)" % str(shut))
+	var door: Dictionary = st2.plan.pieces.filter(func(q): return q["t"] == "door")[0]
+	st2.toggle(door)
+	for k in 90:
+		await tree.process_frame
+	var open := st2.push(Vector3(0, 0.05, -2.0), CosmosWalker.BODY_R)
+	check(open.length() < 0.05 and bool(door["o"]), "opened: through it (%s)" % str(open))
+	st2.queue_free()
+	await tree.process_frame
+
+
+func test_built_and_kept_through_save_and_return() -> void:
+	var c := await _cosmos()
+	c.dry_run = true
+	var pl: CosmosPlanet = null
+	for p: CosmosPlanet in c.planets:
+		if p.shape.kind == "rocky":
+			pl = p
+			break
+	var pid := CosmosBuilds.pid_of(pl)
+	var d := Vector3(0.2, 0.9, 0.4).normalized()
+	var o := d * (pl.radius + pl.shape.height(d) + 0.4)
+	var x := d.cross(Vector3.UP).normalized()
+	CosmosGame.data.add_item("stone", 200)
+	# The builder places a foundation (a new structure there) and walls on it.
+	c.builds._sync_t = 1e9   # (its world set by hand)
+	c.builds.planet = pl
+	c.builds.aim_frame = Transform3D(Basis(x, d, x.cross(d)), o)
+	var ok := c.builds.place(null, _pc("foundation", Vector3.ZERO))
+	check(ok and c.builds.structures.size() == 1, "a foundation starts a structure")
+	var st: CosmosStructure = c.builds.structures[0]
+	var placed := 0
+	for e in BuildKit.edges(st.plan.pieces[0]):
+		if c.builds.place(st, _pc("wall", e[2], BuildKit.r_facing(e[3]))):
+			placed += 1
+	check_eq(placed, 4, "four walls on it")
+	check(c.builds.place(st, _pc("floor", Vector3(0, BuildKit.WALL_H, 0))), "a ceiling on them")
+	var recs: Array = CosmosGame.extra["structures"][pid]
+	check(recs.size() == 1 and (recs[0]["pieces"] as Array).size() == 6, "in the save's extras")
+	var stj: Dictionary = JSON.parse_string(JSON.stringify(CosmosGame.snapshot(c)))
+	c.queue_free()
+	await tree.process_frame
+	await tree.process_frame
+	CosmosGame.begin_state(stj)
+	var c2 := await _cosmos()
+	var recs2: Array = CosmosGame.extra.get("structures", {}).get(pid, [])
+	check(recs2.size() == 1 and (recs2[0]["pieces"] as Array).size() == 6, "loaded: the structure's 6 pieces")
+	var pl2: CosmosPlanet = null
+	for p: CosmosPlanet in c2.planets:
+		if CosmosBuilds.pid_of(p) == pid:
+			pl2 = p
+	c2.builds._sync_t = 1e9
+	c2.builds.planet = pl2
+	c2.builds.reload()
+	var st2: CosmosStructure = c2.builds.structures[0] if not c2.builds.structures.is_empty() else null
+	check(st2 != null, "raised again on its world")
+	if st2:
+		await _wait_built(st2)
+		var top := c2.builds.floor_at(pl2, o + d * 3.4)
+		check(absf(top - (o.length() + BuildKit.WALL_H - pl2.radius)) < 0.05, "its ceiling stood on again (%.2f)" % top)
+	c2.queue_free()
+	await tree.process_frame
+
+
+## The towns' buildings: the kit's pieces in each empire's style - walls,
+## doorways, windows, floors, stairs, flat roofs - one mesh a town, its solids
+## all boxes (the town plans draw them), every building with a way in.
+func test_towns_built_from_the_kit() -> void:
+	for emp in ["minoa", "athens", "sparta", "mycenae", "ionia", "cyclades"]:
+		for kind in ["city", "village"]:
+			var t0 := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+			var made := CosmosTown._make(kind, 5, emp)
+			var ms := (Time.get_ticks_usec() - t0) / 1000.0
+			var nv := 0
+			for m: ArrayMesh in made["meshes"]:
+				nv += (m.surface_get_arrays(0)[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] as PackedVector3Array).size()
+			print("TOWN %s %s: %d vertices, %d solids, %d doors, %.0f ms" % [emp, kind, nv, (made["solids"] as Array).size(), (made["doors"] as Array).size(), ms])
+			check((made["meshes"] as Array).size() >= 2 and (made["meshes"] as Array).size() <= 30, "%s %s: a mesh a block (%d)" % [emp, kind, (made["meshes"] as Array).size()])
+			check(nv < 560000, "%s %s: not too heavy (%d vertices)" % [emp, kind, nv])
+			check((made["solids"] as Array).all(func(b): return b is AABB), "%s %s: its solids all boxes" % [emp, kind])
+			check((made["doors"] as Array).size() >= (12 if kind == "city" else 4), "%s %s: buildings with doorways (%d)" % [emp, kind, (made["doors"] as Array).size()])
+
+
+func test_half_and_quarter_plates() -> void:
+	var plan := BuildPlan.new([])
+	plan.add(_pc("foundation", Vector3.ZERO))
+	# A half against the +x edge: long side on it (2 m deep), or turned: its short side on it, 4 m out.
+	var h := plan.snap("foundation_half", Vector3(3.0, 0, 0.2))
+	check(BuildKit.vec(h["p"]).distance_to(Vector3(3, 0, 0)) < 0.01, "a half foundation against an edge, 2 m deep (%s)" % str(h["p"]))
+	check_eq(plan.check(h.merged({"m": 1})), "", "it fits")

hunks.note: Tools in hand and the scanner's click, the right click freeing the mouse, shots meeting in the reticle, veins scanned and dug, swimming and diving, the worlds orbiting and carrying you, the local pilot boarding, a ridden trader landing, the compass bar and sights.

files.explanation: New: Atrapos Sans is the font everywhere and has every letter the game uses, and no text is ever under 12 px.

@@ -1,0 +1,84 @@ 
+extends TestCase
+## The game's typeface and its text sizes: Atrapos Sans (tools/make_font.py)
+## is the font everywhere - the theme's default, ThemeDB's fallback (what
+## code-drawn text uses), the headings - and it has the letters the game's
+## texts use; and no text is ever under 12 px (Settings.MIN_FONT): the shared
+## helpers clamp, and no script or scene asks for a smaller size.
+
+const REGULAR := "res://assets/fonts/AtraposSans-Regular.ttf"
+const BOLD := "res://assets/fonts/AtraposSans-Bold.ttf"
+
+
+func test_atrapos_sans_everywhere() -> void:
+	var t := NeonTheme.build()
+	check(t.default_font != null and t.default_font.resource_path == REGULAR, "the theme's default font is Atrapos Sans Regular")
+	check(ThemeDB.fallback_font == NeonTheme.body_font(), "ThemeDB's fallback font (code-drawn text) is it too")
+	check(NeonTheme.heavy_font().resource_path == BOLD, "headings: Atrapos Sans Bold")
+	var tf := NeonTheme.title_font() as FontVariation
+	check(tf != null and tf.base_font.resource_path == BOLD, "the title: Atrapos Sans Bold")
+	check(t.get_font("bold_font", "RichTextLabel") == NeonTheme.heavy_font(), "[b] in rich text: the Bold")
+	check(not NeonTheme.body_font().fallbacks.is_empty(), "symbols it lacks come from the bundled fallbacks")
+	# Every letter and the usual marks the game's texts use, from the face itself.
+	var f: Font = NeonTheme.body_font()
+	var missing := ""
+	for ch in "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789.,:;!?'\"“”‘’()[]{}/\\|_-+=<>°%&*@#€£$~^`·•×–—−›‹…µëéèêàáâäöüçñßΑΒΓΔΕΖΗΘΙΚΛΜΝΞΟΠΡΣΤΥΦΧΨΩαβγδεζηθικλμνξοπρσςτυφχψωάέήίόύώ":
+		if not (f as FontFile).has_char(ch.unicode_at(0)):
+			missing += ch
+	check(missing == "", "Atrapos Sans has every letter the game uses (missing: %s)" % missing)
+
+
+func test_helpers_never_under_12() -> void:
+	var m := Settings.MIN_FONT
+	check_eq(m, 12, "the smallest text size is 12 px")
+	var l := UI.label("x", 8)
+	check(l.get_theme_font_size("font_size") >= m, "UI.label clamps (asked 8, got %d)" % l.get_theme_font_size("font_size"))
+	var n := UI.note("x", 9)
+	check(n.get_theme_font_size("font_size") >= m, "UI.note clamps")
+	var b := UI.button("x", func(): pass, 10)
+	check(b.get_theme_font_size("font_size") >= m, "UI.button clamps")
+	for cat in ["hud", "menu", "world"]:
+		check(Settings.fs(cat, 6) >= m, "Settings.fs(%s) clamps" % cat)
+	l.free()
+	n.free()
+	b.free()
+
+
+## A size under 12 written into a script or a scene: font size overrides,
+## the helpers' size arguments, Settings.fs, draw_string's size.
+func test_no_literal_text_under_12() -> void:
+	var pats := [
+		'font_size_override\\("[a-z_]+",\\s*(\\d+)\\)',
+		'font_sizes/[a-z_]+\\s*=\\s*(\\d+)\\b',
+		'Settings\\.fs\\("[a-z]+",\\s*(\\d+)\\)',
+		'UI\\.(?:label|note)\\((?:"(?:[^"\\\\]|\\\\.)*"|[^,()"]+(?:\\([^()]*\\))?)(?:\\s*%\\s*(?:\\[[^\\]]*\\]|[^,()]+(?:\\([^()]*\\))?))?,\\s*(\\d+)\\s*[,)]',
+		'draw_(?:string|string_outline|multiline_string)\\(.*HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_[A-Z]+,\\s*[^,]+,\\s*(\\d+)\\s*[,)]',
+		'\\bfont_size\\s*=\\s*(\\d+)\\b',
+	]
+	var res: Array[RegEx] = []
+	for p in pats:
+		var r := RegEx.new()
+		check(r.compile(p) == OK, "pattern compiles: %s" % p)
+		res.append(r)
+	var bad: Array = []
+	for path in _files("res://scripts", ".gd") + _files("res://scenes", ".tscn"):
+		var lines := FileAccess.get_file_as_string(path).split("\n")
+		for i in lines.size():
+			for r in res:
+				for mt in r.search_all(lines[i]):

+func _files(dir: String, ext: String) -> Array:

files.explanation: New: the sea's life is only under water and never on dry land, its cells are built the same every time, it streams in and out round the camera, and the underwater look is on only below the surface.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,205 @@ 
+extends TestCase
+## Under the sea (CosmosUnderwater): the floor's life scattered by cells round
+## the eye - deterministic, only under the water, none on dry land - streamed
+## in and out as the eye moves; the underwater look on only while the camera
+## is under the surface; the animals kept in the water.
+
+var _old_system := ""
+
+
+func setup() -> void:
+	_old_system = Galaxy.current_system
+	if Galaxy.systems.is_empty():
+		Galaxy._new_game_begin(true, false)
+	Cosmos.arrive_from = ""
+
+
+func teardown() -> void:
+	Galaxy.current_system = _old_system
+	Cosmos.arrive_from = ""
+
+
+func _amnissos_rec() -> Dictionary:
+	for r in Cosmos.planet_records(Galaxy.HOME):
+		if str(r.get("name", "")) == "Amnissos":
+			return r
+	return {}
+
+
+## A direction whose floor is between `lo` and `hi` m under the sea (or the driest, hi < 0... see callers).
+func _spot(shape: PlanetShape, lo: float, hi: float) -> Vector3:
+	for i in 4000:
+		var d := Vector3(sin(i * 1.7 + 0.3), cos(i * 2.3), sin(i * 0.9 + 1.0)).normalized()
+		var depth := -shape.height(d)
+		if depth > lo and depth < hi:
+			return d
+	return Vector3.ZERO
+
+
+func _highest(shape: PlanetShape) -> Vector3:
+	var best := Vector3.UP
+	var bh := -INF
+	for i in 3000:
+		var d := Vector3(sin(i * 1.3 + 0.7), cos(i * 1.9), sin(i * 0.7 + 2.0)).normalized()
+		var h := shape.height(d)
+		if h > bh:
+			bh = h
+			best = d
+	return best
+
+
+static func _positions(buf: PackedFloat32Array, w: int) -> Array:
+	var out: Array = []
+	for i in buf.size() / w:
+		out.append(Vector3(buf[i * w + 3], buf[i * w + 7], buf[i * w + 11]))
+	return out
+
+
+func _area(shape: PlanetShape, dz: Dictionary, d: Vector3) -> Dictionary:
+	var keys := CosmosUnderwater.cells_round(shape.radius, d * shape.radius, CosmosUnderwater.RANGE)
+	return CosmosUnderwater._build_area(shape, dz, keys, keys, {}, d * shape.radius)
+
+
+func test_life_only_under_the_sea() -> void:
+	var rec := _amnissos_rec()
+	check(not rec.is_empty(), "Amnissos is in the home system")
+	var shape := PlanetShape.of(rec)
+	check_eq(shape.sea, 1, "Amnissos has a sea of water")
+	var dz := CosmosUnderwater.design_of(shape, int(rec.get("seed", 1)))
+	check(dz["plants"].size() >= 6, "kelp, sea grass, corals, sponges, urchins (%d kinds)" % dz["plants"].size())
+	check_eq(dz["fish"].size(), 3, "three kinds of fish")
+	var wet := _spot(shape, 6.0, 20.0)
+	check(wet != Vector3.ZERO, "a stretch of sea 6-20 m deep")
+	var a := _area(shape, dz, wet)
+	var n := 0
+	var dry := 0
+	for i in (a["bufs"] as Array).size():
+		for p: Vector3 in _positions(a["bufs"][i], 12):
+			n += 1
+			if shape.height(p.normalized()) > -0.3 or p.length() > shape.radius:
+				dry += 1
+	for p: Vector3 in _positions(a["rock_buf"], 16):
+		n += 1
+		if shape.height(p.normalized()) > -0.3:
+			dry += 1
+	check(n > 200, "the sea floor round a diver is full of life (%d things)" % n)
+	check_eq(dry, 0, "nothing on dry land or above the surface")
+	check(not (a["rocks"] as Array).is_empty(), "boulders and corals to bump into")
+	# A mountain top: no sea round it, nothing there.
+	var top := _highest(shape)
+	check(shape.height(top) > 20.0, "Amnissos has high ground (%.0f m)" % shape.height(top))
+	var b := _area(shape, dz, top)
+	var m := 0
+	for i in (b["bufs"] as Array).size():
+		m += (b["bufs"][i] as PackedFloat32Array).size() / 12
+	m += (b["rock_buf"] as PackedFloat32Array).size() / 16
+	check_eq(m, 0, "on a mountain top, no sea life")
+
+
+func test_cells_are_deterministic() -> void:
+	var rec := _amnissos_rec()
+	var shape := PlanetShape.of(rec)
+	var dz := CosmosUnderwater.design_of(shape, int(rec.get("seed", 1)))
+	var wet := _spot(shape, 4.0, 15.0)
+	var keys := CosmosUnderwater.cells_round(shape.radius, wet * shape.radius, CosmosUnderwater.RANGE)
+	check(keys.size() > 12 and keys.size() < 200, "a few dozen cells round the eye (%d)" % keys.size())
+	var same := true
+	var any := 0
+	for k in keys.slice(0, 6):
+		var c1 := CosmosUnderwater.cell(shape, dz, k)
+		var c2 := CosmosUnderwater.cell(shape, dz, k)
+		for i in (c1["bufs"] as Array).size():
+			any += (c1["bufs"][i] as PackedFloat32Array).size()
+			same = same and c1["bufs"][i] == c2["bufs"][i]
+		same = same and c1["rock_buf"] == c2["rock_buf"]
+	check(same, "a cell is built the same every time (its own seed)")
+	# Every spot in one cell only: the neighbours' areas overlap, their cells don't double up.
+	var k2 := CosmosUnderwater.cells_round(shape.radius, (wet * shape.radius) + wet.cross(Vector3.UP).normalized() * 30.0, CosmosUnderwater.RANGE)
+	var shared := keys.filter(func(k): return k2.has(k))
+	check(not shared.is_empty() and shared.size() < keys.size(), "moving on, some cells stay and some are new (%d of %d kept)" % [shared.size(), keys.size()])
+
+
+func _cosmos() -> Cosmos:
+	Galaxy.current_system = Galaxy.HOME
+	var c: Cosmos = load(Cosmos.SCENE).instantiate()
+	tree.root.add_child(c)
+	var t0 := Time.get_ticks_msec()
+	while not c.build_settled() and Time.get_ticks_msec() - t0 < 30000:
+		await tree.process_frame
+	return c
+
+
+func _wait(cond: Callable, ms := 15000) -> bool:
+	var t0 := Time.get_ticks_msec()
+	while not cond.call() and Time.get_ticks_msec() - t0 < ms:
+		await tree.process_frame
+	return cond.call()
+
+
+func test_streamed_round_the_camera_and_on_only_under_water() -> void:
+	var c := await _cosmos()
+	var pl: CosmosPlanet = null
+	for p: CosmosPlanet in c.planets:
+		if str(p.rec.get("name", "")) == "Amnissos":
+			pl = p
+	if not check(pl != null, "Amnissos is built"):
+		c.queue_free()
+		return
+	var uw := CosmosUnderwater.new()
+	uw.cosmos = c
+	c.add_child(uw)
+	c.cam.set_process(false)
+	c.cam.set_physics_process(false)
+	var d := _spot(pl.shape, 10.0, 25.0)
+	var depth := -pl.shape.height(d)
+	c.cam.global_position = pl.global_position + d * (pl.radius - depth * 0.5)
+	var ok := await _wait(func(): return uw.planet == pl and not uw.shown_cells.is_empty() and uw._apply.is_empty() and uw._area_task == -1)
+	check(ok, "the sea round the camera streamed in")
+	await tree.process_frame
+	check(uw.under, "the camera %.1f m under the surface is under water" % (depth * 0.5))
+	check(uw._fx.visible and uw._glow.visible and uw._snow.visible, "the underwater look on")
+	check(uw._root.visible, "the sea's life drawn")
+	var atmo := pl.get_node_or_null("Atmosphere") as Node3D
+	check(atmo == null or not atmo.visible, "the air's shells not drawn under the sea (covered)")
+	var total := 0
+	for k in uw.counts:
+		total += int(uw.counts[k])
+	check(total > 200, "plants, corals and rocks round it (%d)" % total)
+	check(uw.counts.get("kelp", 0) + uw.counts.get("seagrass", 0) > 0, "kelp or sea grass")
+	check(uw._swimmers.size() >= 7, "fish schools, rays, an eel, jellyfish (%d groups)" % uw._swimmers.size())
+	# The animals keep to the water.
+	var local := c.cam.global_position - pl.global_position
+	for i in 300:
+		uw._swim(0.05, local)
+	var wet := 0
+	var shown := 0
+	for sw in uw._swimmers:
+		if not sw.placed:
+			continue
+		shown += 1
+		var h := pl.shape.height(sw.pos.normalized())
+		if sw.pos.length() < pl.radius - 0.3 and sw.pos.length() > pl.radius + h - 0.6:
+			wet += 1
+	check(shown > 0 and wet == shown, "every animal under the surface, over the floor (%d of %d)" % [wet, shown])
+	# Up out of the water: the look off, the life hidden (still kept - a dive's ready).
+	c.cam.global_position = pl.global_position + d * (pl.radius + 12.0)
+	await tree.process_frame
+	await tree.process_frame
+	check(not uw.under and not uw._fx.visible and not uw._root.visible, "above the surface: nothing of it drawn")
+	check(not uw.cells.is_empty(), "...but kept, near the sea")
+	check(atmo == null or atmo.visible, "the air's shells back")
+	# Swim on: new cells in, the far ones out.
+	var before: Array = uw.shown_cells.duplicate()
+	var t := d.cross(Vector3.UP).normalized()
+	var d2 := (d * pl.radius + t * 60.0).normalized()
+	c.cam.global_position = pl.global_position + d2 * (pl.radius - 2.0)
+	ok = await _wait(func(): return uw.shown_cells != before and uw._area_task == -1)
+	check(ok and uw.shown_cells.any(func(k): return not before.has(k)), "moved on 60 m: new cells streamed in")
+	# Far up: all of it let go.
+	c.cam.global_position = pl.global_position + d * (pl.radius + 3000.0)
+	ok = await _wait(func(): return uw.planet == null, 3000)
+	check(ok and uw.cells.is_empty() and uw._root == null, "flown away: the sea's life let go")
+	check(not uw._fx.visible, "...and no underwater look")
+	c.queue_free()
+	await tree.process_frame
+	await tree.process_frame

files.explanation: New: builds Atrapos Sans, the game's own wide geometric typeface, from code with fontTools: every glyph is put together from rounded rectangles, stems and slanted strokes combined by a small boolean engine. It writes Regular and Bold, 319 glyphs each.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,960 @@ 
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Atrapos Sans - the game's own typeface, built from code.
+
+A wide, geometric "extended square" sans: round letters are rounded rectangles
+(superellipse corners, flat sides), diagonals end in horizontal cuts, the
+lowercase a and g are single-storey, the figures are tabular. Every glyph is
+put together from a few primitives - rectangles, rounded-rectangle rings,
+slanted strokes - combined with union / difference / intersection (a small
+boolean engine below: all edges split where they cross, the pieces between
+inside and outside kept, chained into clean contours with no overlaps).
+
+    python3 -I tools/make_font.py            # writes assets/fonts/AtraposSans-{Regular,Bold}.ttf
+    python3 -I tools/make_font.py --specimen <png>   # also renders a specimen (needs PIL)
+
+Then `godot --headless --import`. Units per em 1000; cap height 680, x-height
+470, ascenders = cap height, short descenders. Two weights: Regular (body
+text) and Bold (headings, titles) - the same drawings with a heavier stroke.
+"""
+import math
+import os
+import sys
+from multiprocessing import Pool
+
+from fontTools.fontBuilder import FontBuilder
+from fontTools.pens.ttGlyphPen import TTGlyphPen
+from fontTools.agl import UV2AGL
+
+ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+OUT_DIR = os.path.join(ROOT, "assets", "fonts")
+FAMILY = "Atrapos Sans"
+VERSION = "1.000"
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- geometry
+class Region:
+    def leaves(self):
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    def inside(self, x, y):
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+
+class Poly(Region):
+    """Filled area of closed contours (nonzero winding)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, contours):
+        self.contours = [c for c in contours if len(c) >= 3]
+        xs = [p[0] for c in self.contours for p in c]
+        ys = [p[1] for c in self.contours for p in c]
+        self.bb = (min(xs), min(ys), max(xs), max(ys)) if xs else (0, 0, 0, 0)
+
+    def leaves(self):
+        return [self]
+
+    def inside(self, x, y):
+        b = self.bb
+        if x < b[0] or x > b[2] or y < b[1] or y > b[3]:
+            return False
+        w = 0
+        for c in self.contours:
+            n = len(c)
+            for i in range(n):
+                x0, y0 = c[i]
+                x1, y1 = c[(i + 1) % n]
+                if y0 <= y:
+                    if y1 > y and (x1 - x0) * (y - y0) - (x - x0) * (y1 - y0) > 0:
+                        w += 1
+                elif y1 <= y and (x1 - x0) * (y - y0) - (x - x0) * (y1 - y0) < 0:
+                    w -= 1
+        return w != 0
+
+    def map(self, f):
+        return Poly([[f(p) for p in c] for c in self.contours])
+
+
+class Union(Region):
+    def __init__(self, parts):
+        self.parts = [p for p in parts if p is not None]
+
+    def leaves(self):
+        return [l for p in self.parts for l in p.leaves()]
+
+    def inside(self, x, y):
+        return any(p.inside(x, y) for p in self.parts)
+
+    def map(self, f):
+        return Union([p.map(f) for p in self.parts])
+
+
+class Diff(Region):
+    def __init__(self, a, subs):
+        self.a, self.subs = a, [s for s in subs if s is not None]
+
+    def leaves(self):
+        return self.a.leaves() + [l for s in self.subs for l in s.leaves()]
+
+    def inside(self, x, y):
+        return self.a.inside(x, y) and not any(s.inside(x, y) for s in self.subs)
+
+    def map(self, f):
+        return Diff(self.a.map(f), [s.map(f) for s in self.subs])
+
+
+class Inter(Region):
+    def __init__(self, a, b):
+        self.a, self.b = a, b
+
+    def leaves(self):
+        return self.a.leaves() + self.b.leaves()
+
+    def inside(self, x, y):
+        return self.a.inside(x, y) and self.b.inside(x, y)
+
+    def map(self, f):
+        return Inter(self.a.map(f), self.b.map(f))

+
+def U(*parts):
+    return Union(list(parts))

+
+def D(a, *subs):

+
+def I(a, b):

+
+def move(r, dx, dy=0.0):
+    return r.map(lambda p: (p[0] + dx, p[1] + dy))
+
+
+def scale(r, sx, sy=None, ox=0.0, oy=0.0):
+    sy = sx if sy is None else sy
+    return r.map(lambda p: (ox + (p[0] - ox) * sx, oy + (p[1] - oy) * sy))
+
+
+def rot180(r, cx, cy):
+    return r.map(lambda p: (2 * cx - p[0], 2 * cy - p[1]))

+
+def mirror_x(r, cx):
+    return r.map(lambda p: (2 * cx - p[0], p[1]))
+
+
+def mirror_y(r, cy):
+    return r.map(lambda p: (p[0], 2 * cy - p[1]))

+
+def slant(r, k, oy=0.0):
+    return r.map(lambda p: (p[0] + (p[1] - oy) * k, p[1]))

+
+SUPER_N = 2.6        # superellipse exponent of the corners (2 = circle)
+ARC_STEPS = 9
+
+
+def _corner(cx, cy, r, q):
+    """Quarter superellipse around (cx, cy), quadrant q (0 = bottom-right, CCW)."""
+    pts = []
+    for i in range(ARC_STEPS + 1):
+        t = (i / ARC_STEPS) * math.pi / 2 + q * math.pi / 2 - math.pi / 2
+        c, s = math.cos(t), math.sin(t)
+        x = math.copysign(abs(c) ** (2 / SUPER_N), c)
+        y = math.copysign(abs(s) ** (2 / SUPER_N), s)
+        pts.append((cx + r * x, cy + r * y))
+    return pts
+
+
+def rr_pts(x0, y0, x1, y1, r, c=(1, 1, 1, 1)):
+    """Rounded-rectangle contour, CCW. c = which corners round (bl, br, tr, tl)."""
+    r = max(0.0, min(r, (x1 - x0) / 2, (y1 - y0) / 2))
+    pts = []
+    if c[0] and r > 0:
+        pts += _corner(x0 + r, y0 + r, r, 3)[0:]
+    else:
+        pts.append((x0, y0))
+    if c[1] and r > 0:
+        pts += _corner(x1 - r, y1 - (y1 - y0) + r, r, 0)
+    else:
+        pts.append((x1, y0))
+    if c[2] and r > 0:
+        pts += _corner(x1 - r, y1 - r, r, 1)
+    else:
+        pts.append((x1, y1))
+    if c[3] and r > 0:
+        pts += _corner(x0 + r, y1 - r, r, 2)
+    else:
+        pts.append((x0, y1))
+    return pts
+
+
+def box(x0, y0, x1, y1):
+    return Poly([[(x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x1, y1), (x0, y1)]])
+
+
+def rbox(x0, y0, x1, y1, r, c=(1, 1, 1, 1)):
+    return Poly([rr_pts(x0, y0, x1, y1, r, c)])
+
+
+def poly(*pts):
+    return Poly([list(pts)])
+
+
+def diag(xa, ya, xb, yb, s):
+    """A slanted stroke from (xa, ya) to (xb, yb), its ends cut horizontally,
+    s thick across."""
+    dy = abs(yb - ya)
+    L = math.hypot(xb - xa, yb - ya)
+    hw = s * L / max(dy, 1e-6) / 2
+    return poly((xa - hw, ya), (xa + hw, ya), (xb + hw, yb), (xb - hw, yb))
+
+
+def seg(xa, ya, xb, yb, s):
+    """A straight stroke with square (butt) ends."""
+    L = math.hypot(xb - xa, yb - ya)
+    nx, ny = -(yb - ya) / L * s / 2, (xb - xa) / L * s / 2
+    return poly((xa + nx, ya + ny), (xa - nx, ya - ny), (xb - nx, yb - ny), (xb + nx, yb + ny))
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------ the boolean
+def _seg_inter(a, b, c, d):
+    """Parameters on ab where cd crosses or touches it."""
+    rx, ry = b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]
+    sx, sy = d[0] - c[0], d[1] - c[1]
+    den = rx * sy - ry * sx
+    qx, qy = c[0] - a[0], c[1] - a[1]
+    rr = rx * rx + ry * ry
+    out = []
+    if abs(den) < 1e-9 * (rr + sx * sx + sy * sy):
+        # parallel: collinear overlap -> c, d split ab
+        if abs(qx * ry - qy * rx) < 1e-6 * math.sqrt(rr) and rr > 0:
+            for p in (c, d):
+                t = ((p[0] - a[0]) * rx + (p[1] - a[1]) * ry) / rr
+                if 1e-9 < t < 1 - 1e-9:
+                    out.append(t)
+        return out
+    t = (qx * sy - qy * sx) / den
+    u = (qx * ry - qy * rx) / den
+    if -1e-9 <= u <= 1 + 1e-9 and 1e-9 < t < 1 - 1e-9:
+        out.append(t)
+    return out
+
+
+def outline(region):
+    """The region's boundary as clean contours (CCW outside, CW holes)."""
+    segs = []
+    for leaf in region.leaves():
+        for c in leaf.contours:
+            n = len(c)
+            for i in range(n):
+                a, b = c[i], c[(i + 1) % n]
+                if abs(a[0] - b[0]) + abs(a[1] - b[1]) > 1e-7:
+                    segs.append((a, b))
+    bbs = [(min(a[0], b[0]) - 1e-6, min(a[1], b[1]) - 1e-6, max(a[0], b[0]) + 1e-6, max(a[1], b[1]) + 1e-6) for a, b in segs]
+    pieces = []
+    for i, (a, b) in enumerate(segs):
+        bi = bbs[i]
+        ts = [0.0, 1.0]
+        for j, (c, d) in enumerate(segs):
+            if i == j:
+                continue
+            bj = bbs[j]
+            if bj[0] > bi[2] or bj[2] < bi[0] or bj[1] > bi[3] or bj[3] < bi[1]:
+                continue
+            ts += _seg_inter(a, b, c, d)
+        ts.sort()
+        for k in range(len(ts) - 1):
+            t0, t1 = ts[k], ts[k + 1]
+            if t1 - t0 < 1e-9:
+                continue
+            p = (a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t0, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t0)
+            q = (a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t1, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t1)
+            L = math.hypot(q[0] - p[0], q[1] - p[1])
+            if L < 1e-6:
+                continue
+            mx, my = (p[0] + q[0]) / 2, (p[1] + q[1]) / 2
+            e = 0.02
+            nx, ny = -(q[1] - p[1]) / L * e, (q[0] - p[0]) / L * e
+            inl = region.inside(mx + nx, my + ny)
+            inr = region.inside(mx - nx, my - ny)
+            if inl != inr:
+                pieces.append((p, q) if inl else (q, p))
+    # dedupe, then chain
+    def key(p):
+        return (round(p[0], 3), round(p[1], 3))
+    seen = set()
+    starts = {}
+    edges = []
+    for p, q in pieces:
+        k = (key(p), key(q))
+        if k in seen or k[0] == k[1]:
+            continue
+        seen.add(k)
+        edges.append((p, q))
+        starts.setdefault(k[0], []).append(len(edges) - 1)
+    used = [False] * len(edges)
+    loops = []
+    for i in range(len(edges)):
+        if used[i]:
+            continue
+        loop = []
+        cur = i
+        while cur is not None and not used[cur]:
+            used[cur] = True
+            p, q = edges[cur]
+            loop.append(p)
+            nxt = [j for j in starts.get(key(q), []) if not used[j]]
+            if not nxt:
+                cur = None
+            elif len(nxt) == 1:
+                cur = nxt[0]
+            else:   # pinch point: take the sharpest right turn
+                dx, dy = q[0] - p[0], q[1] - p[1]
+                h = math.atan2(dy, dx)
+
+                def turn(j):
+                    a, b = edges[j]
+                    t = math.atan2(b[1] - a[1], b[0] - a[0]) - h
+                    while t <= -math.pi:
+                        t += 2 * math.pi
+                    while t > math.pi:
+                        t -= 2 * math.pi
+                    return t
+                cur = min(nxt, key=turn)
+        if len(loop) >= 3:
+            loops.append(loop)
+    return [c for c in (_clean(l) for l in loops) if c]
+
+
+def _area(c):
+    return sum(c[i][0] * c[(i + 1) % len(c)][1] - c[(i + 1) % len(c)][0] * c[i][1] for i in range(len(c))) / 2
+
+
+def _clean(loop):
+    pts = [(int(round(x)), int(round(y))) for x, y in loop]
+    changed = True
+    while changed and len(pts) >= 3:
+        changed = False
+        out = []
+        n = len(pts)
+        for i in range(n):
+            a, b, c = pts[i - 1], pts[i], pts[(i + 1) % n]
+            if b == c:
+                changed = True
+                continue
+            cr = (b[0] - a[0]) * (c[1] - b[1]) - (b[1] - a[1]) * (c[0] - b[0])
+            if cr == 0 and (b[0] - a[0]) * (c[0] - b[0]) + (b[1] - a[1]) * (c[1] - b[1]) >= 0:
+                changed = True
+                continue
+            out.append(b)
+        if len(out) < len(pts):
+            pts = out
+            # rebuild from scratch each pass so neighbours are re-checked
+    if len(pts) < 3 or abs(_area(pts)) < 4:
+        return None
+    return pts

+        self.sb = 74 if bold else 70          # side bearing, caps

+        return max(R - (min(self.S, self.H) if s is None else s), R * 0.32)

+    def ring(self, x0, y0, x1, y1, R=None, c=(1, 1, 1, 1), sx=None, sy=None):

+        sy = self.H if sy is None else sy
+        ri = self.ri(R, min(sx, sy))
+        outer = rr_pts(x0, y0, x1, y1, R, c)
+        inner = list(reversed(rr_pts(x0 + sx, y0 + sy, x1 - sx, y1 - sy, ri, c)))
+        return Poly([outer, inner])

+# ------------------------------------------------------------- building
+def _job(args):
+    bold, ch = args
+    m = M(bold)
+    reg, adv = _all(bold)[ch]
+    if reg is None:
+        return ch, [], adv
+    return ch, outline(reg), adv
+
+
+_cache = {}
+
+
+def _all(bold):
+    if bold not in _cache:
+        _cache[bold] = glyphs(M(bold))
+    return _cache[bold]
+
+
+def gname(ch):
+    cp = ord(ch)
+    return UV2AGL.get(cp, "uni%04X" % cp)
+
+
+def build(bold, pool):
+    m = M(bold)
+    chars = sorted(_all(bold).keys())
+    res = pool.map(_job, [(bold, c) for c in chars], chunksize=4)
+    order = [".notdef"]
+    cmap = {}
+    glyf = {}
+    metrics = {}
+    # .notdef: a hollow box
+    pen = TTGlyphPen(None)
+    for c in outline(m.ring(0, 0, 500, m.C, 0, sx=60, sy=60)):
+        _draw(pen, [(x + 50, y) for x, y in c])
+    glyf[".notdef"] = pen.glyph()
+    metrics[".notdef"] = (600, 50)
+    names = {}
+    for ch, contours, adv in res:
+        n = gname(ch)
+        if n in names.values():
+            n = "uni%04X" % ord(ch)
+        names[ch] = n
+        if n not in glyf:
+            order.append(n)
+            pen = TTGlyphPen(None)
+            for c in contours:
+                _draw(pen, c)
+            glyf[n] = pen.glyph()
+            xs = [p[0] for c in contours for p in c]
+            metrics[n] = (adv, min(xs) if xs else 0)
+        cmap[ord(ch)] = n
+    style = "Bold" if bold else "Regular"
+    fb = FontBuilder(1000, isTTF=True)
+    fb.setupGlyphOrder(order)
+    fb.setupCharacterMap(cmap)
+    fb.setupGlyf(glyf)
+    fb.setupHorizontalMetrics(metrics)
+    asc, desc = 930, 270
+    fb.setupHorizontalHeader(ascent=asc, descent=-desc)
+    fb.setupNameTable({
+        "familyName": FAMILY,
+        "styleName": style,
+        "uniqueFontIdentifier": "%s %s %s" % (FAMILY, style, VERSION),
+        "fullName": "%s %s" % (FAMILY, style),
+        "psName": "AtraposSans-" + style,
+        "version": "Version " + VERSION,
+        "copyright": "Made for Space Atrapos by tools/make_font.py",
+    })
+    fb.setupOS2(sTypoAscender=asc, sTypoDescender=-desc, sTypoLineGap=0, usWinAscent=asc + 30, usWinDescent=desc + 40,
+                sxHeight=m.X, sCapHeight=m.C, usWeightClass=700 if bold else 400,
+                fsSelection=(0x20 if bold else 0x40) | 0x80, achVendID="ATRP", version=4)
+    fb.setupPost()
+    fb.setupHead(unitsPerEm=1000, macStyle=1 if bold else 0)
+    path = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "AtraposSans-%s.ttf" % style)
+    fb.save(path)
+    return path, len(order)
+
+
+def _draw(pen, c):
+    # contours come CCW (inside on the left); TrueType wants outer contours clockwise
+    pts = list(reversed(c))
+    pen.moveTo(pts[0])
+    for p in pts[1:]:
+        pen.lineTo(p)
+    pen.closePath()

+def specimen(paths, png):
+    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
+    lines = [
+        (paths[1], 72, "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"),
+        (paths[0], 64, "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"),
+        (paths[1], 72, "0123456789"),
+        (paths[0], 48, ".,:;!?'\"“”‘’()[]{}/\\|_-+=<>°%&*@#€£$~^`"),
+        (paths[0], 48, "ΑΒΓΔΕΖΗΘΙΚΛΜΝΞΟΠΡΣΤΥΦΧΨΩ αβγδεζηθικλμνξοπρσςτυφχψω"),
+        (paths[0], 48, "ÀÁÂÃÄÅÇÈÉÊËÑÖØÜß àáâãäåçèéêëñöøüÿ ŠšŽžČč"),
+        (paths[0], 32, "Regular: Dock at Athens Station, sell 12 t of olive oil for 1,480 cr. Shields 87% · hull 100%"),
+        (paths[1], 32, "Bold: THE AUTOMATON · INVENTORY · MISSIONS · STATION MARKET"),
+        (paths[0], 18, "Small text, 18 px: Sparta's patrol saw a pirate near the gate (2.4 km). Press F to dock."),
+        (paths[0], 14, "Smaller, 14 px: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog - 0123456789 - Μυκήνες, Αθήνα."),
+    ]
+    img = Image.new("RGB", (2400, 1020), (8, 5, 2))
+    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
+    y = 30
+    for path, size, text in lines:
+        f = ImageFont.truetype(path, size)
+        d.text((40, y), text, font=f, fill=(255, 140, 40))
+        y += int(size * 1.45) + 10
+    img.save(png)
+
+
+def main():
+    os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
+    with Pool() as pool:
+        paths = []
+        for bold in (False, True):
+            p, n = build(bold, pool)
+            paths.append(p)
+            print("%s: %d glyphs" % (os.path.relpath(p, ROOT), n))
+    if "--specimen" in sys.argv:
+        specimen(paths, sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--specimen") + 1])
+

hunks.title: Atrapos Sans from code
hunks.note: Primitives become regions; unions, differences and intersections of them become each glyph; the boolean engine turns those into clean TrueType contours; fontTools writes the two weights in parallel.

bubbles.text: A region only needs its leaf polygons and an inside test; Union, Diff and Inter answer inside by combining their parts', so any boolean shape can be built without touching geometry.
The corners are superellipses, not circles: flatter sides and squarer corners.
Splits every edge of every leaf where it crosses another, keeps each piece with the inside on one side and the outside on the other, then chains the pieces into loops.

bubbles.at: else:   # pinch point: take the sharpest right turn
bubbles.text: Where two loops touch at a point, taking the sharpest turn keeps them as separate clean contours.
Both weights come from the same drawings; only the stems and corner radii change.
One-stem letters (i l I 1 ! j .) get 14 units more each side so il1 and l. read apart.
